rows.title: Client Success Information Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Cognitive Credit is the fastest growing specialist credit data provider across the US, UK & Europe. We are a financial technology company that works with the world’s largest investment banks, asset managers, and hedge funds.
We are looking for an entry level Information Analyst to join our Client Success team, focused on document management.
The Information Analyst will be responsible for maintaining a range of financial reports for the entirety of the private credit issuers within our coverage universes.
We are looking for a candidate with sharp attention to detail, great collaborative working style and desire to continuously improve processes. They will work closely with the wider Client Success team, including the Senior / Lead Data & Client Success Analysts. This position reports to the Client Success Leadership team and has great exposure to working directly with colleagues with vast experiences within credit markets and financial services.
This role offers regular exposure to clients and a unique opportunity to build the skills needed to either progress into a client-facing role with account ownership or pursue a career as a Data Analyst.
About Cognitive Credit:
Cognitive Credit develops advanced analytics software for global credit investors, working with the world’s leading investment banks, asset managers, and hedge funds. Our application automates the majority of credit analysts’ workflow to free up institutional investors’ resources and empower analysts to deliver better results. We are the must-have data analytics product for global credit investors.
Primary Responsibilities:

Keeping processes in sync to ensure timely and accurate client delivery
Owning and maintaining data sets, maintaining documents available to clients for each of our private credit issuers within the multiple coverage universes, to ensure the latest information presented to clients is up to date and accurate.
Managing access to multiple private data sites
Ensuring only our approved clients have access to the private credit models
Reviewing and reconciling incoming client coverage lists
Clearly communicate requirements and outcomes to clients
Work closely with Client Success Managers and escalate to them when client issues need their input


Skills and Qualifications:

Highly detail oriented
Ability to learn processes quickly, with a mindset to spotting efficiency improvements
Results-focused mindset and a willingness to be hands-on with close attention to detail
Strong collaboration skills required to work seamlessly with the wider analyst and client success team
Strong communication skills required for effective stakeholder management
Excellent organization skills with the ability to handle multiple projects concurrently and operate in a fast-paced work environment
Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities - must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver in both short- and long-term projects in a high-stress environment
Contribute to a positive team atmosphere and company culture
Commitment to work flexible hours
Fluent in English
Right to Work in UK


Cognitive Credit is growing quickly and continually evolving. We expect roles will also develop and evolve. We are looking for entrepreneurial people who are excited to do whatever it takes to help us grow our company.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Bachelors degree, minimum 2.1 classification1-3 years of industry experience, with a preference towards operational and / or research roles.

A strong interest in operations, investment banking, accounting, or consulting experience is preferred.Strong financial and computer skills.Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff.Strong analytical capabilities and excellent verbal and written communication skills.

rows.title: Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary
Flight Management is a mission-critical airline operations solution that supports the preparation of every flight before departure. Our products enable airlines to optimise aircraft loading, calculate aircraft weight and balance, generate regulatory-compliant load sheets, manage operational changes, and ensure flights depart safely, efficiently, and on time. These solutions operate within a complex ecosystem of interconnected products, services, operational processes, and external integrations where reliability, accuracy, and compliance are critical.You will work within Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Managers, Technical Business Analysts, Architects, Quality Engineers, domain experts, and airline customers. Your mission will be to translate complex operational requirements into scalable technical solutions, leveraging modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring solution quality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, solution design capabilities, technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across complex systems and integrations. You should be comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, and technology stacks, while leveraging modern engineering and AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities 
Analyse functional and technical requirements to understand solution objectives and implementation considerations.Design and deliver scalable, maintainable, secure, and reliable software solutions aligned with product and architectural objectives.Implement APIs, integrations, messaging, and data exchange mechanisms across interconnected products and services.Collaborate with Product Managers, Technical Business Analysts, Architects, Quality Engineers, and domain experts to refine requirements and validate solutions.Implement and maintain automated testing and validation capabilities to support quality, reliability, and continuous delivery.Participate in peer reviews, technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives.Review and validate implementation artefacts, including AI-assisted outputs, to ensure compliance with engineering, security, performance, and operational standards.Investigate defects, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities throughout the software lifecycle.Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve solution design, development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery effectiveness.
Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.At least 3 years of experience in software development or a similar engineering role.Experience working in Agile product development environments.Strong software engineering, solution design, and systems modelling skills.Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise software solutions.Understanding of APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and software architecture principles.Experience working with complex, interconnected systems and cross-product workflows.Experience developing automated tests and applying quality engineering practices.Familiarity with source control, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices.Strong communication and collaboration skills.Ability to effectively leverage AI-assisted engineering tools and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, including designs, code, tests, and technical documentation, to improve delivery effectiveness and solution quality. Experience with AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) practices is a plus.
Nice to Have
Familiarity with airline or airport operations, including flight operations, aircraft weight and balance, load control, baggage handling, or ramp operations.Experience working with mission-critical, safety-critical, or highly regulated systems.Experience building APIs, event-driven solutions, distributed applications, or service-oriented architectures.Experience with cloud-native architectures and modern deployment practices.Experience with observability, monitoring, operational support, or site reliability engineering practices.Experience with SQL, messaging technologies, event streaming platforms, or complex data processing.Experience contributing to software solutions that incorporate AI-powered capabilities, automation, decision support, conversational experiences, or agentic workflows.
This role is suited to individuals who enjoy working at the intersection of business, operations, and technology, translating complex operational requirements into clear, scalable, and reliable solutions that support critical airline operations.
Who We AreScalian UK is a consultancy, specialising in digital systems and business management and performance, working in 12 countries, including France, Spain, Belgium, the UK, Germany, the USA, and Canada. Ranked in the top 10 engineering consulting firms in France, the Group provides services in industrial project management, quality management, supply chain performance and development of digital and information systems. It also helps clients address digital transformation challenges for the industry and the service sectors.
As of 2024, the Group includes 5,500 people, with a turnover of €550 million. More information can be found at - https://www.scalian.com/en/
Note: Visa sponsorship is not currently available for this position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may require visa sponsorship in the future, subject to business needs and eligibility requirements

rows.title: Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Marketing Manager – International events & media £50k + bonus (c£5k OTE) Central London – Hybrid 
Ark is exclusively partnering with an established international media and events business serving the global maritime, ports and logistics sector.
Following a period of transformation and growth, the business is investing heavily in its commercial team and looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to drive revenue across digital media, editorial partnerships, content solutions and international events.
This is an excellent opportunity for a strong delivery focused and strategic minded marketing professional who enjoys working across different projects, driving event attendance, branding and supporting clients with digital solutions, working closely with sales, editorial and event delivery teams.
The RoleYou'll take ownership of the marketing, across their 3 global conferences, driving delegate attendance and sponsorship attraction campaigns, genuinely adding to the revenue generated for each event.This role will also see you supporting and adding your marketing insight for the editorial, media and digital solutions side of the business, thinking strategically about you can support the growth and add value across those divisions too.
What you'll be doing:-Own and deliver the marketing strategy, with a particular focus on driving delegate registrations, attendance and engagement across the events and webinars.Plan and manage multi-channel marketing campaigns from initial idea through to delivery, continually reviewing performance and looking for ways to improve results.Work closely with the commercial, operations and editorial teams to align marketing activity, support sales and ensure campaigns, content launches and sponsor deliverables are delivered effectively.Develop a strong understanding of audience and data, using insight to grow and segment the database and target the right markets and job functions.Lead email marketing activity, using segmentation, A/B testing and performance data to improve engagement and conversions.Oversee digital presence across website, social media and paid campaigns, identifying opportunities to improve engagement, SEO and conversion.Work closely with the designer and wider team to develop high-quality marketing collateral across events, campaigns, social media, email and sales activity.Promote the company’s editorial output, including journals, news and insight content, to grow readership, subscribers and engagement.Track, analyse and report on campaign performance, using data and market insight to shape future strategy and demonstrate ROI.Represent the business key industry events, with occasional international travel involved (Europe, US & Asia)Work with external agencies, freelancers and partners where required.
About You4+ years' experience in Events Marketing, ideally international conferencesExperience working alongside editorial teams, or within a media focused business would be beneficial but not essentialProven track record of delivering audience and attendance growth for eventsExperience using HubSpot would be a huge plus!Hands on, ideas person with a strategic mindsetExcellent communication, presentation and personal skills – able to work with key stakeholders internally and externally!Sector experience within maritime, logistics, transport or technology is advantageous but not essential.We're particularly interested in candidates from media, publishing, events, digital marketing, business intelligence or B2B information services backgrounds.

If you're an experienced events marketer looking to join a respected international brand and play a key role in its next phase of growth, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or get in touch with Robyn for more information – robyn@ark-recruitment.com

rows.title: Client & Brand Relations Coordinator, Harrods

London is our home, our heartbeat, and we draw inspiration from the energy and spirit of the city, its diversity and creativity. For over fifty years our team of in-house shoe and accessory designers have been creating authentic, distinctive designs from our London headquarters. The rainbow is our signature. It represents the good energy and love we have for our community and the many ways we collectively express our individual style.

rows.title: Customer Retention Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Customer Retention Manager

YOU WILL NOT BE EMPLOYED BY INSTANT IMPACT, THIS ROLE IS BEING ADVERTISED ON BEHALF OF A CUSTOMER. 

Role purpose

The Customer Retention Manager is responsible for dealing with day-to-day customer support requests to improve customer satisfaction, promote self-service digital tools, identify growth opportunities and proactively reduce churn across the company’s customer base.

This role plays a key part in delivering a more proactive, insight-led retention strategy and in improving the collection and use of customer data and CRM tools to identify risks early, resolve issues, and create opportunities for growth.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

Customer service and issue resolution

 Serve as a key contact for customer queries or requests, resolving matters promptly and escalating more complex requirements when needed Carry out proactive check-ins with customers to monitor satisfaction, identify risks, and spot growth opportunities Share customer experience insights internally to support continuous improvement

Onboarding and offboarding

 Deliver a smooth onboarding experience, ensuring customers are set up for success from day one Manage offboarding processes where needed, with clear communication on requirements and timescales to set expectations

Customer Hub and self-service adoption

 Drive adoption of the Customer Hub and self-service tools, helping customers use available digital services confidently Encourage digital-first handling of routine requests to improve speed, consistency, and customer experience

Customer insight and data

 Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer information and data in CRM systems to support retention activity and effective use of the Customer Hub Use customer data, feedback, and behavioural indicators to identify trends and risks Contribute to the development of customer segmentation (e.g. high value, at risk, growth) and prioritisation strategies

Retention and churn management

 Proactively engage high-value or at-risk customers to spot churn risks early and enable timely action to improve outcomes. Escalate and help resolve issues that may impact retention, working closely with internal teams

Customer Experience Improvement

 Gather and share customer insight to help improve products, services, and processes Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to drive continuous improvement Support initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction and retention outcomes

Collaboration

 Work closely with Internal teams to deliver joined-up customer management Feed retention opportunities and risks into relevant teams

Key outcomes / measures of success

 Improved customer retention rates and reduced churn Increased customer satisfaction (e.g. NPS / OSAT) Higher engagement with Customer Hub and digital services Effective identification and management of at-risk customers Strong quality and completeness of customer data

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Essential

 Strong relationship management skills with a customer-first mindset Proven ability to identify and manage customer risk and retention opportunities Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Ability to work with data and insights to inform decisions Proactive and organised, with strong problem-solving skills

Desirable

 Experience in customer operations environments Experience using CRM systems to manage customer relationships and campaigns Understanding of customer lifecycle management and retention strategies

Ways of working / behaviours

 Customer-focused: puts customer outcomes at the centre of decisions Proactive: identifies issues early and takes action Collaborative: works effectively across teams to solve problems Data-led: uses insight to prioritise activity and improve outcomes Practical and solution-oriented: focuses on what will make the biggest difference

rows.title: B2C CRM Marketing Executive (Commercial Moments & Reactive Comms)
rows.descriptionText:
We're looking for a hands-on CRM Executive to build, QA and ship our reactive comms calendar and support key commercial moments across 14 markets and languages. Reporting to our B2C CRM Manager, you will create briefs and turn them into flawlessly executed campaigns in Braze - on time, correctly targeted, correctly localised. You'll work at pace on time-sensitive sends, coordinate creative production, making sure customers get the right message at the right time.

🧐 You Will Be Responsible For

Campaign build and delivery: Build broadcast campaigns end to end in Braze - templates, segments, workflows, personalisation logic and scheduling - across email, push, in-app and content cards.Reactive execution: Turn around time-sensitive and urgent sends at speed, working to the reactive calendar and priorities set by the CRM Manager.Key commercial moments: Deliver campaign plans and activity for key commercial moments (Black Friday, seasonal peaks, key dates) against agreed strategic direction, ensuring campaigns land on time and drive maximum customer engagement and revenue impact.QA: Self-QA every campaign against the agreed checklist - targeting, links, copy, creative, personalisation, localisation - and submit for review before scheduling.Localisation delivery: Adapt and localise central campaigns across 14 markets, coordinating translations and market-specific variants.Creative Excellence & Testing: Coordinate content and creative production with Design and Content, and run a structured A/B testing programme to continuously improve engagement and conversion.Reporting and continuous improvement: Report campaign performance per send, against agreed benchmarks - highlighting what worked well and what needs improving, so learnings feed into the next campaign rather than being re-learned.Reactive comms optimisation: Continuously optimise reactive communications, apply our customer segmentation, and manage the calendar for maximum impact, balancing send frequency, relevance, and commercial priorities across the customer base.Local marketing support: Support local market teams with ad- hoc marketing initiatives and requests, ensuring central campaigns are adapted and localised effectively.

And....breathe.

But we're not done yet. We're on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.

If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.

Hands-on ESP experience (essential). 1+ years building and deploying campaigns in Braze or similar, including segmentation and scheduling.Technical comfort. Able to navigate HTML/CSS edits — not coding from scratch, but confident tweaking and adding elements. Agile & data-driven: Highly analytical, with a proven track record of using data and A/B testing to inform and optimise campaign performance.Execution & delivery mindset: A true "doer" who thrives on turning commercial moments and reactive briefs around quickly and building campaigns end-to-end, without losing sight of quality.Structured yet scrappy: Highly structured in managing the execution of a busy, multi-market comms calendar, yet scrappy and agile when a reactive moment needs to move fast."Local and Global": Prepared to engage with (and semi-regularly meet) local marketing teams across Europe to better understand market nuances and customer needs / wants to improve CRM campaigns.

rows.title: CRM Specialist – Jumpman Gaming
rows.descriptionText:

Location: Hybrid/Remote in the UK | Department: CRM Marketing | Employment Type: Full-Time

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About The Role

We’re looking for a highly technical CRM marketer to design, build, and optimize sophisticated lifecycle programs across multiple channels.

You’ll serve as a Braze subject matter expert, owning the end-to-end execution of CRM programs—from audience segmentation and journey architecture to personalization, experimentation, and technical troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable architecting complex Braze Canvases, building Content Card experiences, writing advanced Liquid personalization logic, and solving technical problems independently.

Experience with SMS and WhatsApp is a plus as we continue to expand our omnichannel capabilities.

What You’ll Do

Own lifecycle strategy and automation architecture

Design and build scalable, multi-touch customer journeys that drive meaningful business outcomes. Architect and optimize lifecycle programs across Email, Content Cards, and in-product experiences. Modernize existing journeys through structured experimentation and continuous optimization. 

Build and execute CRM programs in Braze

Serve as a Braze subject matter expert. Build and manage Campaigns, Canvases, and Content Cards. Create advanced personalization using Liquid. Configure dynamic content, audience segmentation, and behavioral triggers. 

Troubleshoot and solve technical problems

Investigate and resolve issues related to audience qualification, journey logic, personalization, data discrepancies, and campaign performance. Partner with Analytics, MarTech, and Engineering teams to diagnose integration and data flow issues. Proactively identify risks and implement scalable solutions. 

Drive experimentation and performance optimization

Design A/B tests with clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria. Analyze performance data to improve audience targeting, customer journeys, and content effectiveness. Share insights and recommendations with stakeholders. 

Partner across the business

Collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Product, Analytics, Engineering, Creative, Sales, and Customer Success teams. Translate business goals into effective CRM strategies. Act as a trusted CRM expert and strategic partner across the organization. 

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation experience, preferably in a B2B environment. 3+ years of hands-on Braze experience. Deep expertise building and managing Braze Canvases. Advanced proficiency with Liquid personalization. Experience designing complex lifecycle automation programs. Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong analytical and experimentation skills. Excellent project management and communication skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment. 

Preferred

Experience with SMS and/or WhatsApp programs. Working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with APIs, customer data platforms (CDPs), or data warehouses. Experience supporting global and multilingual campaigns. Familiarity with AI tools and applying AI to CRM workflows. 

Skills & Experience

Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset 

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description CEERISK Consulting is a multidisciplinary firm that helps corporations identify engineering risks and develop solutions to control hazards and reduce the impact of costly accidents. The company combines deep knowledge of failure mechanisms across systems and equipment with a strong understanding of evolving global standards. CEERISK focuses on the uncertainties created by complex new technologies and globalization, offering expert risk assessment and management strategies. By integrating an understanding of emerging technologies, failure modes, and local business and cultural environments, CEERISK brings greater certainty to the construction, energy, and engineering sectors.
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Data Scientist role based in Kingston Upon Thames. The Data Scientist will collect, clean, and analyze structured and unstructured data to support engineering risk assessments and decision-making. 
Responsibilities include building statistical and machine learning models, developing predictive analytics, and translating complex data insights into clear recommendations for consultants and clients. rows.title: Data Scientist - Consumer Behaviour
rows.descriptionText:
Data Scientist - Consumer BehaviourCentral London / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office (Tuesday to Thursday)Salary range £45,000 - £60,000 depending on skills & experienceRef: J13181
A fantastic opportunity for a Data Scientist looking for the opportunity to work on genuinely interesting problems, apply rigorous statistical thinking to large-scale behavioural data and have a real impact. This is a chance to join a small, high-performing Data Science team where you'll have significant exposure to interesting projects, experienced colleagues and real client challenges.
Working for one of the world's largest consumer behavioural data companies, providing deterministic behavioural data to many of the world's leading brands and platforms, including Google, Meta, Netflix and the BBC.
The Data Science team works with billions of consented consumer events across search, browsing, AI, social, retail, web, app and purchase activity, turning complex data into findings that clients can act on.
You’ll be defining cohorts, choose appropriate statistical approaches, investigate potential sources of bias and communicate your conclusions clearly. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to the data products and pipelines that underpin the organisation's behavioural datasets and client reporting.
The Role:
• Work with large-scale behavioural datasets covering consumer activity across multiple platforms• Define cohorts and datasets using SQL, including complex aggregations, CTEs and window functions• Apply statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals and experimental analysis• Work with causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, difference-in-differences and matching• Investigate selection bias, confounding and other factors that could affect the validity of results• Develop and maintain data aggregation pipelines and datasets used across the business• Contribute to PII detection and client reporting processes• Validate analytical results against source data and investigate unexpected findings• Write clear, maintainable Python code that can be understood and reused by others• Work collaboratively through GitHub, pull requests and code reviews• Present findings, methodologies and caveats clearly to clients and internal stakeholders• Use AI and coding assistants effectively while taking full responsibility for reviewing and validating their output• Contribute to the development of analytical and data products as the team evolves
Skills & Experience:
• 1-3 years' Data Science experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through graduate work, projects or competitions• Strong Python skills, particularly pandas and NumPy• Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions and aggregation• A solid understanding of applied statistics, including hypothesis testing and confidence intervals• MMM (Marketing Mix Modelling) experience, or have worked in this environment• An understanding of selection bias, confounding and the assumptions behind statistical methods• Some knowledge of causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, difference-in-differences or matching• A habit of validating results against the underlying data rather than simply trusting that code has executed successfully• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly• A curious and sceptical mindset, with the instinct to investigate results that don't look right• Experience using AI or coding assistants, alongside the judgement to verify their output before using it
Apply today for a confidential conversation and find out more.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary
Flight Management is a mission-critical airline operations solution that supports the preparation of every flight before departure. Our products enable airlines to optimise aircraft loading, calculate aircraft weight and balance, generate regulatory-compliant load sheets, manage operational changes, and ensure flights depart safely, efficiently, and on time. These solutions operate within a complex ecosystem of interconnected products, services, operational processes, and external integrations where reliability, accuracy, and compliance are critical.You will work within Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Managers, Technical Business Analysts, Architects, Quality Engineers, domain experts, and airline customers. Qualifications

About Sparta Global

Embark on a transformative career journey with Sparta Global, where diversity, innovation, and passion for technology converge. You'll work alongside enthusiastic professionals, receiving top-tier training and mentorship to hone your skills for success in both public and private sectors. As a Top 20 Employer for Social Mobility and a proud B-Corp certified organisation, we're not just advancing careers; we're fostering a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive tech landscape. Grounded in AI adoption, taught by expert trainers, our Consultants enter client projects with the most contemporary AI practices and digital confidence. Join us in shaping the future of technology - where your growth is our mission, and your success, our pride. Apply now to be part of our award-winning team at Sparta Global.

About This Role

You will develop your technical and AI skills in the most exciting industry ready material available today. You will become a versatile Technical Consultant, learning Software Development, Testing, Automation, Data and DevOps. You begin by specialising in one, then receive continuous training to become as well-rounded and marketable as possible. You will improve your soft skills, professional communication, teamwork, leadership, conflict resolution and agile understanding. You will be working closely with other developers, designers, analysts and testers to create, maintain and modify systems to meet the ever-evolving demands of our client. You will write clean, efficient, and well-documented code, troubleshoot and debug issues with existing software, participate in code reviews and provide feedback and new ideas, ironing out the project requirements or planning on how to tackle challenges. You will have access to ongoing support from our internal education platform, online courses and accredited certifications to constantly discover, research and learn new technologies to stay up to date with the latest trends in the industry. 

We're not expecting you to have the proficiencies right away - that's where our award-winning AI and Technology Institute comes in. We are the experts in building skills and confidence in a fun and supportive environment that will not only challenge you but also develop your specialist capabilities ready to work on our clients' projects.

Why You Should Apply

Our environment is designed to nurture your talents and skills, your hard work and progress are not just appreciated - they're tangibly rewarded. We conduct performance-based reviews every six months, providing you the chance to increase your earning potential twice a year. This regular appraisal system is our way of ensuring that your efforts and achievements are consistently recognised and rewarded.

Unlike other companies, we do not charge you for our training content and do not enforce a training bond. Our training is underpinned with market leading AI practices designed to progressively build your skills and future-proof your career.

We Also Provide

20 days annual leave + bank holidays and religious allowances An extra day off for your birthday Pension Cycle to work scheme Season ticket loan Employee assistance program Yearly budget for personal development Access to alumni and community networks 

Being employed by Sparta Global is an investment in your future that pays dividends along the way. We give you breadth of experience and skills, along with increasing opportunities to develop further and earn more. No two career paths look the same at Sparta.

What we're looking for

To be successful for this role you will need to demonstrate a level of ability in Python and SQL. You will be passionate about technology and eager to learn full stack programme development to an advanced level.

We're Seeking Candidates Who Can Exemplify Our Values

Empathy and Diversity: Integrity, respect, and a commitment to inclusivity.

Drive: A goal-oriented mindset with pride in exceeding targets.

Collaboration: A team-focused approach, fostering positive relationships.

Innovation: Curiosity, creativity, and openness to diverse ideas.

Flexibility: Adaptability and composure in the face of change.

As a national organisation with clients across the UK, we require all candidates to have the flexibility and willingness to relocate post training for deployment to client site. Remote working cannot be guaranteed. You must have eligibility to work in the UK for the duration of your contract with Sparta Global (British or Irish Citizenship, EU Settled Status, or Permanent Visa Holder). We do not offer visa sponsorships or accept Graduate or PSW Visas due to time limitations.

Our Recruitment Process

Begin your journey by applying online and our team will review your application. If you pass our initial screening, you'll be invited to complete our online assessments and first stage interview. If successful, the final stage is an online meeting whereby you’ll pitch yourself to our Head of Talent, here you'll have the opportunity to impress us with your ability to communicate effectively and exhibit behavioural competencies through relevant examples. We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate a collaborative spirit, a growth mindset and confident articulation of their skills.

The Talent Team will be there to support and answer any questions you have. You can also visit our YouTube channel to gain valuable insights and expert advice on virtual interviews, strategies to manage nerves, and tips on nonverbal communication.

Data Scientist - Consumer BehaviourCentral London / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office (Tuesday to Thursday)Salary range £45,000 - £60,000 depending on skills & experienceRef: J13181
A fantastic opportunity for a Data Scientist looking for the opportunity to work on genuinely interesting problems, apply rigorous statistical thinking to large-scale behavioural data and have a real impact. This is a chance to join a small, high-performing Data Science team where you'll have significant exposure to interesting projects, experienced colleagues and real client challenges.
Working for one of the world's largest consumer behavioural data companies, providing deterministic behavioural data to many of the world's leading brands and platforms, including Google, Meta, Netflix and the BBC.
The Data Science team works with billions of consented consumer events across search, browsing, AI, social, retail, web, app and purchase activity, turning complex data into findings that clients can act on.

• 1-3 years' Data Science experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through graduate work, projects or competitions• Strong Python skills, particularly pandas and NumPy• Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions and aggregation• A solid understanding of applied statistics, including hypothesis testing and confidence intervals• MMM (Marketing Mix Modelling) experience, or have worked in this environment• An understanding of selection bias, confounding and the assumptions behind statistical methods• Some knowledge of causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, difference-in-differences or matching• A habit of validating results against the underlying data rather than simply trusting that code has executed successfully• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly• A curious and sceptical mindset, with the instinct to investigate results that don't look right• Experience using AI or coding assistants, alongside the judgement to verify their output before using it

rows.title: Quant Talent Researcher
rows.descriptionText:
Market Research Associate | Quantitative Research & Trading📍 London | 💼 Hunter Bond | 🚀 Career Path into Quant Recruitment
Hunter Bond is growing its Quantitative Research & Trading desk, and we're looking for a Market Research Associate to join the team.
This is an opportunity for someone who is naturally curious, analytical and interested in financial markets to get deep into the world of Quant Trading while building the foundations for a career in specialist recruitment.
You don't need previous recruitment experience.
Instead, you'll start by learning the market from the ground up, understanding the firms, the people, the strategies and the talent behind some of the world's leading hedge funds and proprietary trading firms.
You'll work closely with Amir, who joined Hunter Bond earlier this year to build our Quant Research & Trading desk. With 10+ years of experience across agency recruitment and internal talent acquisition at major hedge funds, Amir brings extensive experience of this exact market and will be closely involved in your development.
🔎 What will you actually be doing?
Your initial focus will be research and market intelligence.
You'll be figuring out who the key people are, where they work, what they're working on and where the movement is happening across the market.
You'll:Map the global Quant Research, Quant Trading and Systematic Trading talent landscapeResearch leading hedge funds, prop shops and market makersIdentify and track high-calibre quantitative talentBuild detailed talent pools and candidate pipelinesMonitor hiring trends, competitor activity and movement across the marketSupport recruiters on live searches and specialist hiring projectsDevelop a strong understanding of different firms, strategies and candidate backgroundsKeep market and candidate intelligence organised across our internal systems
And as your knowledge develops, your role develops with it.
You'll gradually move from research into candidate outreach, building relationships with people in the market and eventually conducting your own screening calls and conversations with senior Quant professionals.
📈 Where can it take you?This isn't designed to be a research role that you stay in indefinitely.It's a pathway into becoming a specialist Quant recruiter.You'll start by learning how the market works.Then you'll start speaking to it.Then you'll start owning it.The aim is to give you the knowledge and confidence to progress into a full Recruitment Consultant position, with responsibility for your own candidates, relationships and desk.
🧠 Who are we looking for?You don't need to be a Quant.But you should be the kind of person who wants to understand how things work.We're looking for someone who is:Naturally curious and interested in financial markets, trading or technologyAnalytical and comfortable working with large amounts of informationHighly organised and detail-orientedConfident communicating with peopleAmbitious and motivated to progressComfortable working towards targetsA quick learner who enjoys getting to grips with complex subjectsInterested in eventually moving into a more commercial, candidate-facing role
A background in research, finance, recruitment, sales, market intelligence, economics, mathematics, computer science or another analytical discipline could be useful, but it's not essential.
🚀 What you'll getSpecialist training in Quantitative Trading and RecruitmentDirect mentorship from an experienced Quant recruitment specialistExposure to leading hedge funds, prop trading firms and market makersA structured route from research → candidate engagement → recruitmentCompetitive salary + performance-based incentivesThe opportunity to build expertise in a genuinely niche marketA growing team where you can progress alongside the deskA long-term career path within a specialist recruitment business
Why join now?The Quant desk is still being built.
That means you're not stepping into a role where everything has already been decided — you'll be joining early and growing with it.
If you're someone who enjoys researching, learning and understanding niche markets but also wants a career that can eventually become highly commercial and relationship-driven, this could be a very good place to start.
Interested? Apply now or get in touch with Devon at dperry@hunterbond.com for more information.

Hybrid working pattern (3/2)
An opportunity has arisen for a Risk Analyst to join a leading global energy trading organisation based in London.
This role since within the analytics team which constantly strives to improve risk procedures through automation, therefore a significant aspect of the role would be to contribute to the development of software to streamline daily processes and assist front office with system trading, using a variety of techniques including machine learning and artificial intelligence.

Preparing and reviewing daily P&L and risk reports, monitoring limits, and proactively resolving any issues in coordination with the relevant teams. rows.title: Associate, Quantitative Research
rows.descriptionText:
About This Role

BlackRock is one of the world’s preeminent asset management firms and a premier provider of global investment management, risk management and advisory services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors around the world. BlackRock offers a range of solutions — from meticulous fundamental and quantitative active management approaches aimed at maximizing outperformance to highly efficient indexing strategies designed to gain broad exposure to the world’s capital markets. Our clients can access our investment solutions through a variety of product structures, including individual and institutional separate accounts, mutual funds and other pooled investment vehicles, and the industry-leading iShares® ETFs.

Elevate your career by joining the world's largest asset manager! Thrive in an environment that cultivates positive relationships and recognizes outstanding performance! We know you want to feel valued every single day and be recognized for your contribution. At BlackRock, we strive to empower our employees and actively engage your involvement in our success.

Systematic Active Equity (SAE) is the quantitative equity group within BlackRock’s Systematic investment group. We invest our client assets using a systematic investment approach. SAE is a pioneer and thought leader in the industry and has consistently achieved client investment goals across global equity markets for over 30 years. We believe research and innovation are critical to continuing our success and believe in a multi-disciplinary approach that intersects traditional finance and economics with data and computer science.

We are seeking a Systems Researcher who will primarily focus on computer science, data management, mathematical models, and computer simulations. The main skills for this role are outstanding execution of algorithmic development and software engineering. The Systems Researcher will be part of our investment and quantitative research teams.

We Have

$200bn + billion USD under management. A team of world-class quantitative finance researchers and portfolio managers. Through BlackRock, access to some of the best investors and thought leaders, as well as to leading experts in statistics, machine learning, and optimization. A 40-year plus track record of performance and innovation. 

You Have

The desire to work in a team environment with computer scientists, data scientists, and quantitative investors of many different backgrounds. A passion for algorithmic development and implementation, and a keen attention to detail. A fascination for some aspects of computer science: distributed computing, cryptography, and machine learning. Working knowledge of serverless architecture, ideally having developed or contributed to projects in that space. A Bachelors, Masters, or Ph.D. in computer science with 2+ years of applied experience. A proven track record of delivering awesome software. Excellent knowledge of Python / Pandas, as well as Java or C/C++. Well-rounded proficiency with Linux and UNIX systems. Experience in distributed computing and the use of GPUs

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

rows.title: Research Analyst | Competition Practice | London
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About The Role

We are looking to hire Research Analysts who will have an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one. As a Research Analyst, you will become an integral part of a project team tasked with advising on the competitive impact of a merger or conduct. You will have a critical role in researching, analysing and interpreting the way that competition works in your client’s industry. Your analysis will form the fundamental basis of expert advice that will be given to clients, competition authorities and/or courts. You will work closely with your team to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence.

Research Analysts join us after completing their undergraduate degree in a quantitative subject. If you are in the process of completing or have already completed a Master's degree in economics, we would encourage you to apply to the Analyst position.

This is a two-year fixed-term position, ideal for candidates who are interested in post-graduate studies in economics but would like to gain work experience and a better understanding of economic consulting before returning to university.

Applications for an Autumn 2027 start close on 29th January 2027.

Key Responsibilities

Analysing and interpreting significant amounts of client data in order to deeply understand how competition works in your client’s industry. This will involve, in particular, analysing customer data, price and cost data and competitor data / market sharesResearching how firms compete with each other and identifying the most important variables that affect their decision making processesIdentifying and summarising all the relevant facts to understand a client’s industryTaking responsibility for quality control and ensuring accuracy and error-free work productDrafting reports interpreting and summarising analysis

Skills/profile Sought

Undergraduate degree in economics, ideally with a focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometricsHighly analyticalExcellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-taskAbility to communicate effectively with colleagues and clientsAccuracy and attention to detailAbility to work independently and as part of a teamStata and Excel skills desirable

Benefits Of Working At Compass Lexecon

Competitive salary and benefitsA wide variety of interesting and challenging projectsAn international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experienceA blend of professional and academic environmentsThe opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academicsA steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative teamThe opportunity to contribute from day oneFor exceptional Research Analysts, the opportunity to be sponsored for postgraduate study and to move on to our career programme on completion of a Master’s degree.

When Drafting Your Application

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next? 

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does our interview process look like?

Our interview process for Research Analysts involves two stages. The first stage is one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. The second stage includes a 75-minute technical interview. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 peopleAmong the fastest-growing tech companies in the UKProfitable since 2017Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman SachsLoved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Handelsbanken combines a long-established relationship banking model with secure, resilient, and customer-focused technology. Our technology teams enable the Bank’s decentralised way of working, delivering systems built for stability, trust, and long-term value.

We are on a multi-year technology and digital transformation journey to enhance customer experience and improve how colleagues work together. Our decentralised culture extends to technology. Teams are trusted to take ownership, make informed decisions, and deliver sustainable, high-quality solutions. We value engineering excellence, pragmatic problem-solving, and strong collaboration across technology, business, and risk.

We offer technologists the opportunity to build lasting careers, deepen their expertise, and contribute to meaningful change. We look for people who care about quality, security, long-term impact, and who want to shape the future of a relationship-led bank.

We also recognise that flexibility can support people to perform at their best, and that it looks different for everyone. While arrangements will depend on the requirements of the role and the needs of the business, we are open to having a conversation around what flexibility could look like for you.

The Efficiency and Automation team is a multi-disciplinary team responsible for streamlining business processes, reducing administrative burden and enhancing operational efficiency across the Bank. Through a combination of process automation, intelligent automation, agentic workflows and Generative AI, the team delivers frequent, high-impact improvements that enable colleagues to focus more time on value-adding activities and customer service.

As automation technologies continue to evolve, the team is expanding its use of Agentic Automation, Predictive and Generative AI capabilities to automate increasingly complex processes, enhance decision-making and improve employee and customer experiences.

The Bank's strategy is centred around delivering operational efficiencies that create capacity to support increased business volumes and profitability, while improving customer satisfaction and outcomes. The Efficiency and Automation team supports this strategy by identifying and delivering small, frequent improvements that drive measurable business value and accelerate digital transformation.

Key responsibilities

As an AI Engineer you will design build and maintain the software foundations that enable AI use cases to move from idea to production. You will work across backend engineering, data integration, model integration, APIs, orchestration, monitoring and deployment. The role requires strong software engineering discipline and practical experience building and productionise AI use cases from machine learning models to GenAI systems whilst ensuring they are safely deployed.

You will work closely with Product Managers and Data Scientists and should be comfortable working through the phases of the product development cycle end-to-end: understanding the business problem, shaping the technical approach, integrating data sources, building services, connecting models or LLMs, implementing controls and supporting solutions after release.

Design, build and maintain backend services, APIs and orchestration layers that support AI and data-driven use cases across the bank.Develop robust, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, including clean code, automated testing, version control and secure development standards.Integrate AI models, machine learning services and GenAI capabilities into banking workflows, CRM systems and Bank Manager facing applications.Build and maintain data pipelines, feature pipelines and service integrations required to support AI products.Support the deployment and operation of models and AI services, including monitoring, logging, alerting, performance management and incident response.Work with Data Scientists to productionise models, expose model outputs through reliable services and ensure outputs are usable by business applications.Implement safeguards for AI use cases, audit trails and access controls.Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Security and Architecture teams to ensure AI solutions meet internal governance, regulatory and operational resilience expectations.Contribute to reusable engineering patterns, shared components, reference architectures and deployment standards for AI-enabled solutions.Support experimentation and prototyping while ensuring successful use cases can scale into maintainable, production-ready solutions.Contribute to a high-quality engineering culture focused on pragmatism, collaboration, learning and delivery.

Strong software engineering background, ideally with experience building production systems in a complex enterprise or regulated environment.Hands-on experience with Python and SQL, with the ability to build reliable services, data workflows and automation.Experience designing APIs, backend services, batch processes, event-driven workflows or data processing applications.Experience working with containerised environments such as Docker, Kubernetes or similar platforms.Understanding of machine learning lifecycle concepts, including model development, deployment, monitoring and retraining.Experience building and productionising AI use cases GenAI concepts such as LLM integration, prompt orchestration, RAG, Machine Learning Models.Experience integrating data from multiple systems and turning raw data into reliable, usable services or pipelines.Ability to work closely with product, business, data, architecture, security and risk stakeholders.Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ambiguous business problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.

Why join Handelsbanken

We want everyone at Handelsbanken to feel supported, motivated, and able to do great work. That’s why, alongside brilliant colleagues, meaningful work and training and development opportunities, we provide a variety of benefits designed with your wellbeing in mind.

In addition, there is a flexible benefits package with the key highlights detailed below.

rows.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer – OpenAI / Agentic AI
rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

At CGI, you’ll help turn the possibilities of agentic AI into measurable outcomes for organisations operating in complex enterprise environments. Working at the intersection of clients, software engineering and emerging AI, you’ll take ownership of ambiguous challenges and rapidly transform them into prototypes, operational pilots and production-ready solutions.

You’ll have the freedom to explore new approaches using OpenAI Codex and agentic technologies, while collaborating with CGI experts and client teams to deliver secure, scalable solutions. As successful ideas develop, you’ll help shape reusable AI patterns and propositions that can create value across CGI’s clients and sectors—giving you the opportunity to influence how organisations adopt and scale the next generation of AI.

CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee.

We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant.

Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.

This is a hybrid position.

Your future duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will work directly with clients and CGI teams to identify high-value opportunities for agentic AI and turn them into practical, measurable solutions. You will take ownership from early discovery and pre-sales through rapid prototyping, pilot delivery and production deployment, helping clients understand where emerging AI capabilities can deliver genuine business value.

You will have the freedom to experiment and create, developing deep expertise in OpenAI Codex and related agentic technologies while being supported by CGI specialists across architecture, cyber security, cloud, platforms and governance. You will also turn successful implementations into reusable patterns, assets and propositions, helping CGI scale innovation across clients and sectors.

 Discover & Shape – Embed with clients to understand workflows, technology environments and business challenges, identifying high-value opportunities for AI. Prototype & Validate – Rapidly build prototypes, interfaces and MVPs to test ideas against clearly defined workflows and measurable outcomes. Design & Deploy – Build agentic AI systems that integrate securely with client infrastructure, data and operational processes. Engineer & Integrate – Develop across user interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, data and cloud environments. Optimise & Govern – Engineer agent context, tools and orchestration with appropriate permissions, evaluations, guardrails and human oversight. Innovate with Codex – Develop deep expertise in OpenAI Codex and apply AI-assisted engineering to real client development workflows. Scale & Reuse – Convert successful implementations into repeatable agentic patterns, workflows, assets and propositions. Consult & Influence – Deliver technical demonstrations and presentations to technical and non-technical audiences and contribute to RFPs, bids and tenders. Productionise & Improve – Take validated concepts from experimentation through MVPs to secure, robust and scalable production solutions.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

You will bring strong software engineering foundations alongside hands-on experience with AI-assisted or agentic development. You should be comfortable working directly with clients, navigating ambiguity and rapidly turning ideas into working software. Curiosity about emerging AI technologies is important, and you’ll be supported by CGI colleagues as you deepen your expertise and apply new capabilities to complex enterprise challenges.

 Hands-on AI engineering experience – Practical experience with OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools. Agentic AI knowledge – Working knowledge of context engineering, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, gained professionally or through substantial hands-on experimentation. Strong software engineering foundations – Broad understanding of front-end applications, backend services, APIs, integrations and cloud infrastructure. End-to-end delivery experience – Proven ability to take software from experimentation and prototyping through to operational deployment. Client-facing capability – Strong experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, consulting or client-embedded software delivery. Communication skills – Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Adaptability & ownership – Confidence working with ambiguity, changing priorities and emerging technologies while driving work towards practical outcomes.

Experience designing agentic AI applications using technologies such as the Codex SDK/API, OpenAI Agents SDK/API, MCP, skills, subagents or comparable frameworks would be advantageous. Experience with agent evaluation, observability, sandboxing, permissions, human-in-the-loop approaches, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud platforms or deploying AI within secure and regulated environments would also be valuable.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

rows.title: Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
TL;DR: We’re hiring for our Insights team to help our customers unlock the full value of Listen Labs. You’ll partner directly with product, research, and marketing leaders at some of the world’s most innovative companies to translate insights into decisions.

Background

Listen Labs is an AI-powered research platform that helps teams uncover insights from customer interviews in hours — not months. We help customers analyze conversations, surface themes, and make faster, smarter product decisions.

Company highlights — entirely product-led:

World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs (previous AI exit), former co-founders, and talent from Jane Street, Twitter, Stripe, Affirm, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and many more Sequoia-backed startups (plus IOI/ICPC backgrounds). Hypergrowth: We're a fast-growing team backed by top-tier investors that's grown several-fold in the past year, and we're set on multiplying that again. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and love working with people who take ownership. Traction: Rapid growth across segments with enterprise wins at Google, Microsoft, Nestlé, and P&G. Performance: Industry-leading win rate driven by a highly differentiated product. Market Validation: Consistently winning customers across all segments with over six-figure lands that lead to quick expansions. Viral Product: Interviews are shared with tens of thousands of viewers, fueling PLG, organic expansion, and daily inbound from Fortune 500s. 

What You’ll Do

Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, ensure quality assurance, and support the creation of insights briefs and presentations that deliver actionable insights. Become an expert on the Listen platform, advocating for best practices, quota structure, and platform utilization for analysis. Serve as a strategic partner — proactively identifying opportunities to utilize the platform to address customer needs. Support team members with onboarding new customers, supplementing training, and helping customers troubleshoot within the platform. Identify opportunities for process, workflow, and product improvements to enhance the team and client experience. Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Recruitment Ops, Engineering, Sales) to champion the customer perspective and influence roadmap priorities. Move fast — balancing high-quality craft with rapid iteration and experimentation. 

Who You Are

2+ years of experience in client-facing market research or insights roles. Intrinsically motivated with a high attention to detail and organizational skills. Comfortable working across qualitative and quantitative inputs, identifying which methodology would be best suited for business objectives. Strong communicator who can simplify complex ideas and work across teams. Curious, analytical, and relentlessly focused on helping customers succeed. Thrives in ambiguity and fast-changing environments — no passengers, no politics. 

Life at Listen Labs

Competitive Compensation: We're backed by world-class investors, including Sequoia Capital, Ribbit, and Conviction, alongside Evantic, AI Grant, and Pear VC, and offer competitive compensation packages with meaningful equity ownership in a market where over 30B has been created in adjacent industries (Medallia, AlphaSense, GLG, Ipsos, Kantar). Our Sequoia partner, Bryan Schreier, was the first investor in Qualtrics—a $12B company tackling similar problems to ours. The range for this role is $85,000 – $110,000 base. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, experience, and work location. If this range doesn't match your expectations, we still encourage you to apply. Benefits that Support You: Comprehensive healthcare and dental coverage, flexible time off to recharge, and an environment that values balance and trust. Room to Grow: As an early member of the team, you’ll have the opportunity to take on new responsibilities, shape processes from scratch, and grow alongside the company. We value people who want to stretch beyond their role and build something lasting.

Reporting to the Manager, Provider Data Management, the Provider Data Analyst supports processes, standards, and other daily provider data operations in the system of record (SOR) Salesforce. General Competencies

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Cartesia is building the future of real-time audio intelligence, and inbound demand for our models is growing fast. We're looking for a hungry, high-velocity Inbound GTM Strategist to own our inbound motion, similar to an Inbound SDR or BDR role elsewhere. As the first person focused fully on inbound, you'll be the first conversation for developers, startups, and enterprises who reach out, getting each one to the right next step and helping set how we qualify, route, and hand off leads to AEs. What You Bring
