2027 BNY Analyst Program – People, Engagement, and Impact

People Practice powers business growth by creating an environment that inspires individuals to join the company, empowers them to develop, and motivates them to stay. We drive commercial results through integrated talent, leadership, and employee-experience solutions. By partnering with the business to attract, develop, and retain top talent, we foster a culture where people and performance thrive together.

What You Will Do

 Support People, Engagement and Impact priorities by contributing to initiatives across people governance, employee relations, public policy, government affairs, regulatory relations, philanthropy, and community impact.  Employee Experience: Analyze and improve onboarding, internal mobility, and broader employee experiences using employee feedback, digital tools, and people insights.  Test AI in Action: Support pilots of generative AI tools that enhance People and Corporate Affairs operations, such as drafting knowledge articles, streamlining communications, or powering internal help bots.  Bring Data to Life: Build or refine dashboards that track key people and Corporate Affairs metrics—such as engagement trends, exit patterns, learning participation, employee relations themes, or community impact measures.  Drive Internal Talent Mobility: Contribute to initiatives that match employees to open roles or projects based on skills, interests, and business needs, helping strengthen workforce agility and career growth.  Voice of the Employee: Help run pulse surveys, focus groups, or feedback exercises and synthesize insights to inform people strategies, governance decisions, and employee-related priorities.  Support Change Initiatives: Create toolkits, communications, and digital materials that help employees navigate change confidently and support broader Corporate Affairs messaging and engagement.  Research Future Skills and External Trends: Conduct competitor and market research to inform evolving skills frameworks, workforce strategy, and broader Corporate Affairs priorities, including policy and regulatory developments.

 Supporting our people across the employee experience with a clear talent strategy for the future and simple, improved people processes and tools  Engaging our stakeholders, including employees, governments, communities and media  Delivering impact by helping BNY adapt to change and strengthen our culture

rows.descriptionText:
Duties Description

Incident Monitoring & Quality Review

 Provide real-time, statewide monitoring and oversight of the incident management function, ensuring serious reportable incidents, abuse allegations, and deaths are accurately classified, thoroughly documented, and addressed with immediate protective measures and required notifications.  Review completed investigations and supporting documentation submitted by providers; identify deficiencies, request additional evidence or investigative work, and ensure accurate data entry into the Incident Report and Management Application (IRMA) and the Vulnerable Persons' Central Register (VPCR).  Review and track Corrective Action Plans (CAPs), follow up with providers to obtain required information, and update IRMA and VPCR systems accordingly.  Analyze IRMA data to identify trends and generate Critical and Significant Event reports. 

Administrative Operations

 Serve as liaison to the NYS Justice Center, responding to inquiries and coordinating requests for additional information regarding investigations and CAPs.  Respond to inquiries from the Justice Center, voluntary and state-operated agencies, and unit colleagues regarding incident management protocols and procedures. 

Technical Assistance, Training & Collaboration

 Provide ongoing training, technical assistance, and system support to state-operated and voluntary provider agencies on incident management protocols and the use of IRMA.  Collaborate with internal and external partners --including the Office of Investigations and Internal Affairs (OIIA), and local committees --to support a coordinated response to serious incidents.  Coordinate with Division of Quality Improvement (DQI) units (BPC and CQI) to share monitoring data and escalate significant untoward events for immediate follow-up.  Participate in local and statewide committees, work groups, and meetings, to contribute to OPWDD incident management initiatives. 

Compliance & Technical Proficiency

 Maintain a comprehensive understanding of 14 NYCRR Part 624 regulations, the Protection of People with Special Needs Act (PPSNA), and IMU administrative processes to provide accurate advice and direction.  Maintain proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, OPWDD and NYS Justice Center databases, and all internal Incident Management Unit (IMU) systems.  Perform other duties as assigned. Telecommuting will be discussed at the interview. 

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nys-office-for-people-with-developmental-disabilities/posts/?feedView=all

A bachelor’s degree in a human services field.

A bachelor’s degree in a human services field and one year of experience in a federal or state certified human service program, which must have been in a professional administrative position in which a major duty involved planning, coordinating, monitoring or evaluating a provision of services for people with developmental disabilities. This experience must have included information gathering and analysis.

Program Operations Specialist 1, SG-18:

A bachelor’s degree in a human services field and two years of experience in a federal or state certified human service program. One year of this experience must have been in a professional administrative position in which a major duty involved planning, coordinating, monitoring or evaluating a provision of services for people with developmental disabilities. rows.descriptionText:
About Eip

Energy Infrastructure Partners LLC (EIP) is a minority-owned business specializing in energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, and demand-side management programs. With offices in New York, Illinois, California, Oregon, Pennsylvania, and Washington, EIP combines national reach with local market understanding. Our work advances sustainable energy solutions, supports economic development, and prioritizes benefits for disadvantaged communities. As a leader in clean energy program implementation and consulting, EIP is proud to help clients achieve meaningful environmental and economic outcomes through innovative, high-impact projects.

Position Description

EIP is seeking a Model Analyst based in Chicago to conduct regression analysis and quantify energy savings for strategic energy management (SEM) programs serving ComEd, PECO, and NYSEG markets. The analyst will build and maintain facility-level energy use models that account for production, weather, occupancy, and other relevant drivers, then use those models to assess changes in performance over time.

Working with engineers, SEM coaches, program managers, and customer teams, the Model Analyst will gather and validate data, select appropriate model variables and time periods, establish baselines, calculate normalized savings, and prepare documentation that supports program reporting and technical review. The role requires careful statistical analysis and the judgment to distinguish meaningful operational improvements from data issues or changes in facility activity.

The ideal candidate can explain modeling assumptions and results clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues, manage recurring analyses for multiple facilities, and adapt methods to each utility program’s measurement and verification requirements.

Objectives of this Role

Reliable Energy Baselines: Develop reproducible regression models that describe normal facility energy use and its relationship to relevant operating conditions. Defensible Savings Estimates: Quantify changes in energy use attributable to SEM activities using approved methods, documented adjustments, and appropriate uncertainty checks. Data Quality: Identify missing, inconsistent, or anomalous utility and driver data before they affect model results or savings claims. Program Compliance: Apply the applicable utility and program measurement and verification protocols consistently across participating facilities. Actionable Insight: Translate model findings into useful feedback for SEM coaches, engineers, customers, and program managers. Timely Delivery: Maintain models and recurring reports on schedule while supporting accurate portfolio-level tracking and continuous improvement. 

Daily and Monthly Responsibilities

Assemble Analysis Data: Collect and organize utility bills, interval meter data, production records, weather data, operating schedules, occupancy, and other drivers relevant to each facility. Validate Data Quality: Check units, time stamps, meter coverage, missing periods, duplicate records, outliers, and changes in operations; document corrections and unresolved limitations. Develop Regression Models: Select appropriate baseline periods and independent variables; build and test facility-level models using suitable statistical tools and program-approved methods. Evaluate Model Performance: Review residuals, explanatory power, bias, error metrics, and the plausibility of coefficients; investigate poor model fit and avoid unsupported savings conclusions. Calculate SEM Savings: Compare observed reporting-period energy use with modeled baseline consumption adjusted to reporting-period conditions; document formulas, inputs, and results. Address Facility Changes: Assess whether equipment, production, schedules, occupancy, or other non-routine changes require model revisions or documented adjustments under program rules. Support Measurement and Verification: Prepare model files, data dictionaries, calculation workbooks, charts, and narratives for internal review, utility reporting, and evaluator requests. Collaborate with Program Teams: Work with SEM coaches and engineers to understand facility operations, validate model drivers, investigate unexpected trends, and interpret results. Communicate Findings: Present baselines, performance trends, savings estimates, assumptions, and uncertainty in concise reports and visualizations suited to the intended audience. Maintain Portfolio Tracking: Update recurring analyses, track analysis status and due dates, reconcile facility results to program reporting, and escalate data or modeling risks. Improve Analytical Practices: Help refine templates, quality checks, documentation standards, and repeatable workflows across SEM programs. 

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, statistics, mathematics, data science, economics, physics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience. Regression Analysis: Demonstrated ability to develop, interpret, and validate multivariable regression models using real-world time-series or operational data. Data Analysis Tools: Strong Excel skills and proficiency with at least one analytical environment such as R, Python, SQL, or a comparable statistical tool. Analytical Judgment: Ability to assess model fit, data quality, variable selection, outliers, seasonality, and uncertainty without relying solely on automated outputs. Technical Documentation: Ability to maintain transparent calculations and explain methods, assumptions, adjustments, and results clearly in writing. Collaboration: Ability to work with engineers, customer-facing teams, and program managers to understand the operational context behind the data. Organization: Ability to manage analyses for multiple facilities and programs, maintain version control, and meet recurring reporting deadlines. 

Preferred Qualifications

SEM Experience: Experience developing energy baselines or calculating savings for strategic energy management, industrial energy management, or related utility programs. Measurement and Verification: Familiarity with whole-facility measurement and verification, normalized metered energy consumption approaches, IPMVP Option C, or utility-specific SEM protocols. Energy Data: Experience working with utility interval data, billing data, weather normalization, industrial production data, or building management system trends. Statistical Methods: Experience evaluating model bias, normalized mean bias error, coefficient of variation of root mean squared error, confidence intervals, or comparable model quality measures where appropriate. Energy Systems: Familiarity with commercial or industrial energy systems and common factors that influence facility energy consumption. Program Markets: Experience supporting ComEd, PECO, NYSEG, or other utility energy efficiency programs. 

WE OFFER

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. ($60k-$75k)Performance-based bonus tied to individual and company performance. 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match. Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays. Professional development and training opportunities. A dynamic, inclusive work environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, and growth. 

Join us!

At EIP, your analysis will help organizations see whether changes in how they operate are producing measurable energy savings. You will bring statistical rigor and practical judgment to SEM programs across multiple utility markets.

Energy Infrastructure Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Note: This is a Chicago-based hybrid position. EIP generally requires four days per week in office when not traveling. Specific in-office requirements will be based on program needs.

EIP does not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

rows.descriptionText:
Why DLC?

DLC is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work and is driven by a strong culture and entrepreneurial foundation. DLC is one of the nation's leading owners and operators of open-air retail shopping centers and has expertise in all facets of commercial real estate. At DLC, our teammates make all the difference and we offer industry-leading training and career development to assure your success.

What We Offer

Compensation and Benefits:Competitive pay401K company matchMedical, Dental, and Vision InsuranceWork-Life Balance:Hybrid work model20+ paid days off annually13+ paid holidays in addition to PTOPaid parental leaveCareer Development:Industry-leading training and developmentOpen door policyIndustry trade shows and event accessMentorship program
About The Role

The Cash Management & Payables Analyst supports the Company's accounts payable and cash management functions by processing invoices, preparing payments, maintaining vendor records, assisting with banking activities, and supporting recurring intercompany transactions. The role plays an important part in ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies and procedures.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions while providing responsive support to internal stakeholders and vendors. This position offers an excellent opportunity to build accounting, treasury, and financial operations experience within a growing commercial real estate organization.

Responsibilities

Process vendor invoices, expense reports, check requests, and other accounts payable transactions.Review invoices for proper coding, approvals, and supporting documentation prior to processing.Maintain vendor records, including vendor setup, W-9 collection, and ongoing maintenance.Assist with weekly payment processing, including checks, ACH payments, wire transfers, and virtual payments.Research and resolve vendor inquiries, payment discrepancies, and outstanding items in a timely manner.Process recurring intercompany charges, management fees, payroll reimbursements, expense reimbursements, and other billback transactions.Assist with cash management activities, including bank deposits, cash receipts, banking transactions, and positive pay administration.Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.Support month-end close activities related to accounts payable, cash management, and intercompany activity.Assist with annual 1099 reporting, audit requests, and special projects as assigned.Collaborate with internal departments to obtain approvals, resolve issues, and ensure transactions are processed efficiently and accurately.Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and operational efficiency.

Soft Skills/Behaviors

Strong data entry and organizational skills with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail.Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Service-oriented mindset with a commitment to responsiveness and follow-through.Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.

Technical Skills

Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred.1+ years of accounting, accounts payable, treasury, bookkeeping, administrative, or related experience preferred.Basic Microsoft Excel proficiency and ability to learn new systems.Experience with MRI, Nexus, Concur, Yardi, or similar financial systems is a plus.

The expected salary for this position is between $65,000 and $75,000. The actual compensation will be based on factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, market and business considerations and other factors permitted by law.

About DLC

Founded in 1991, DLC has been one of the nation’s preeminent owners, operators, and managers of shopping centers. Our portfolio includes millions of square feet of attractive retail space and continues to expand as we complete additional acquisitions.

rows.descriptionText:
Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Crossix is positioned at the center of big data, innovative technology, media, and life sciences. Our mission is to empower life sciences companies with the data and insights they need to drive patient and provider marketing effectiveness and, ultimately, better patient outcomes. As part of Veeva, the Crossix team offers the agility of a high-growth team with the stability of a global leader.

The Role

We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of analytics services professionals through our Analytics Development Program.

What this role is (and isn’t):

What it IS: A data-driven, customer-facing role where you'll work directly with media agencies and pharmaceutical brand teams. You will use the Crossix Measurement Suite to help the world’s leading pharmaceutical brands optimize their marketing, ultimately helping them deliver life-changing treatments to patients more effectively.What it IS NOT: This is not a sales role. You will not be cold-calling, hunting leads, or chasing sales quotas. It is also not a back-end technical programming position.

This role is part of Generation Veeva, and as such you can expect:

A “learn by doing” environment with challenging and impactful work, where you will be expected to learn quickly and deliver earlyA collaborative work environment where you will work closely with many levels of our team, from other early-career professionals through senior leadersMentorship and continuous professional development opportunities, aiding in your immediate and long-term success at Veeva

The anticipated start date is July 2027.

The Analytics Development Program offers two distinct paths. Please review our other track, the Marketing Data Analyst role, to choose the best fit for your skills and interests.

We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

What You'll Do

Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with experienced team members to translate complex healthcare data into compelling, high-impact stories. You will be responsible for providing strategic recommendations that directly influence the multi-million dollar marketing investments of leading global pharmaceutical brands.Consult Directly with Clients: Serve as a strategic advisor to media agencies and pharma brand teams. You will quickly become an expert on the Crossix Measurement Suite, helping clients interpret their data, answer critical business questions, and maximize the value of our platform.Own Your Deliverables: Manage end-to-end client workstreams. In our fast-paced environment where high-performance is rewarded, you will actively manage deliverables, solve real-world problems, and rapidly evolve into a future leader on the Crossix team.

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:

Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to translate quantitative findings into qualitative business recommendations.High Drive & Performance: A self-starter with a track record of excellence who thrives in a demanding and dynamic environment, and is hungry for rapid professional growth.Consultative Communication & Storytelling: Ability to build strong, trusting client relationships and present complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences, from technical analysts to senior executives.Academic Excellence: Bachelor’s degree (any major) with a 3.0 – 4.0 GPA, demonstrating the intellectual curiosity, time management, and work ethic necessary for a high-performance consulting career.Experience Level: This role is designed for upcoming or recent graduates with 0–2 years of post-grad full-time work experience. Location & Presence: You live within about a 45-60 minute commute of our NYC office (or plan to be by your start date) and look forward to collaborating with the team on-site 4 days a week.Unwavering Integrity: Veeva is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a “do the right thing” company. We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and expect honesty and integrity from every team member.

THE PROCESS | Our process is different from most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

Application & Assessment: You submit your resume, responses to a few short application questions, and complete a brief online assessment.Application Response (Within 1 Week): We review every application thoroughly. Within about one week of submission, we will notify you via email whether we’d like to move you to the next stage.Initial Interview: You will participate in a 60-minute job interview with a senior member of our team.Case Interview: If we proceed following your initial interview, you will complete a strategic case exercise. You will be given one full week to prepare for the case.Final Decision (Within 1 Week): Within about one week of completing your case exercise, we will either extend an official offer or let you know that we are not moving forward.Your Decision (2 Weeks): If extended an offer, you will have two weeks to make your final decision. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview for other roles would be an ethical violation in our view.

Perks & Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insuranceFlexible PTO and company paid holidaysRetirement programs1% charitable giving program

Compensation

Starting base pay: $82,500

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT, or TN status) for this employment position.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable providing hands-on operational support, collaborating with property managers, and serving as a knowledgeable point of contact during platform implementations. The position will also support the broader Financial Analyst team with basic analysis and overflow assignments under the guidance of senior team members.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Systems and Workflow Management

Serve as the day-to-day owner and primary point of contact for AvidXchange, Domicile, and ClickPay.Monitor system workflows and ensure transactions, approvals, and other assigned items are processed accurately and on time.Identify workflow issues, investigate their causes, and coordinate resolutions.Escalate technical or operational issues to internal stakeholders or platform providers when necessary.Maintain platform-related procedures, documentation, and user guidance.Recommend opportunities to improve processes, controls, and system utilization.

Provide hands-on support to the AR and AP teams across payment, billing, approval, and reconciliation workflows.Research and resolve transaction discrepancies and processing issues.Assist with monitoring outstanding or exception items and follow up with the appropriate stakeholders.Run recurring and ad hoc reports from the financial platforms as requested.Help ensure financial information is complete, accurate, and available within required timelines.

Serve as a key contact for property managers during new platform implementations, property onboarding, and system transitions.Assist users with system navigation, workflow questions, and issue resolution.Coordinate with Finance, property management teams, vendors, and platform representatives to support successful implementations.Track implementation issues and action items through completion.Provide training and ongoing support to platform users as needed.

Qualifications

Job Title: Experimentation Analyst

Location: New York

Reporting to: Manager, Testing & Customer Insights

Contract Type: Full Time / Permanant

About Us

BBC Studios’ Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business brings premium content directly to North American audiences through two distinctive streaming brands: BritBox and BBC Select.

BritBox, the ultimate streaming destination for British TV. We offer an unparalleled collection of thoughtfully curated entertainment—cleverly crafted and full of the charm, wit, and heart that define British storytelling.

Born from the BBC, our mission is to bring authentic British stories to our audiences. Launched in 2017, we are a small but mighty streamer that punches above our weight—available on every major platform and even featured among the bright lights of Times Square—and we’re just getting started.

BBC Select is a documentary streaming service that has been successfully operating since February 2021. It has established itself as the third-largest documentary streaming service in the US. With plans to expand through original commissions, territorial premieres, and new distribution platforms, BBC Select continues to serve a highly engaged audience that values educational, high-quality content. The integration of BBC Select into the DTC organization presents a strong opportunity to leverage shared capabilities, insights, and expertise to accelerate growth and enhance overall customer experience.

If you’re passionate about entertainment, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to play a meaningful role in our growth journey, this is your opportunity to be part of a dynamic Direct-to-Consumer business within BBC Studios, bringing the very best of British TV to fans everywhere.

Job Purpose

As Experimentation Analyst, you will collaborate closely with multiple departments such as Marketing, Creative, UX and Product to design, execute, and monitor tests. Through testing, you’ll deliver improved results in areas such as paid media, key subscription metrics including trial-to-paid conversion, LTV and retention, and help ensure new launches and tactics are successful from the get-go.

Alongside this, you will help manage the day-to-day A/B testing workflow, from test intake through to results summaries and sharing learnings across the business. You will also communicate regularly with stakeholders to ensure tests are aligned, progress is visible, and insights are translated into clear actions.

This is an opportunity for a self-starter who can dig in and use both data-driven insights and testing techniques to drive growth within our company.

Responsibilities

Test Setup & Execution: Assist in designing and implementing A/B tests and multivariate tests for marketing campaigns, creative assets, and subscriber strategies in product/app, email, push etc.Project Management: Ensure all tests are tracked centrally, making all relevant updates to details and dates, proactively identifying conflicts and ensuring tests will start and end on agreed timelines.Monitoring & Reporting: Regularly monitor test performance, analyze results, and compile reports that detail findings and recommendations for future campaigns.Data Analysis: Utilize analytics tools to evaluate user behavior and conversion metrics, identifying trends and actionable insights to enhance marketing efforts.Collaboration: Work closely with the Senior Manager, marketing team, and creative team to ensure tests align with business goals and user needs.Subscriber Strategy Support: Contribute to the development of strategies aimed at attracting new subscribers and improving retention through data-driven insights.Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in testing and optimization, integrating new methodologies to improve testing processes.Documentation & Communication: Maintain clear documentation of testing protocols and communicate results effectively to stakeholders, ensuring alignment on strategic decisions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Data Science, or a related field.Previous experience in testing, optimization, or analytics, preferably in a digital or subscription-based environment.Understanding of key statistical concepts for hypothesis testing, including confidence intervals, p values, alpha, beta, standard deviation etc.Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (e.g., Optimizely) and marketing automation tools.Familiarity with analytics platforms such as GA4, Meta, etc.Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Google Analytics, SQL, Tableau).Excellent communication skills, able to present complex data insights in a clear and actionable manner.Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Familiarity with AI tools and desire to learn for workflow improvements, test analysis, build and ideation.Passion for data-driven decision-making and improving customer experiences.Bonus: HTML/CSS/JavaScript to directly set up tests in tools such as Optimizely.

Skills And Personal Attributes

Passionate about British TV and SVOD.Motivated by working in a fast-paced media environment.Natural project manager, able to manage self & others to complete tasks on time and communicate clear deliverables and expectations.Excited to pioneer and continually evolve a new platform for testing & optimization.Proven ability to translate analytics into actionable insights.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.We work flexibly at BritBox; to support new markets, some work may be conducted outside of US business hours to coordinate with territories in other time zones.This job spec is not exhaustive and may change from time to time in line with the evolving nature of a dynamic and growing business.

Please note that the salary range is intended to give as an indicator of the salaries that could be attributed to the breadth or experience for a given role. All candidates will be measured based on their level of experience.

Our values have been cascaded into specific behaviours, which are embedded into all of our people processes, including hiring, onboarding, performance evaluation and feedback.

EIP is seeking a Model Analyst based in Chicago to conduct regression analysis and quantify energy savings for strategic energy management (SEM) programs serving ComEd, PECO, and NYSEG markets. The analyst will build and maintain facility-level energy use models that account for production, weather, occupancy, and other relevant drivers, then use those models to assess changes in performance over time.

Working with engineers, SEM coaches, program managers, and customer teams, the Model Analyst will gather and validate data, select appropriate model variables and time periods, establish baselines, calculate normalized savings, and prepare documentation that supports program reporting and technical review. The role requires careful statistical analysis and the judgment to distinguish meaningful operational improvements from data issues or changes in facility activity.

The ideal candidate can explain modeling assumptions and results clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues, manage recurring analyses for multiple facilities, and adapt methods to each utility program’s measurement and verification requirements.

Objectives of this Role

Reliable Energy Baselines: Develop reproducible regression models that describe normal facility energy use and its relationship to relevant operating conditions. Defensible Savings Estimates: Quantify changes in energy use attributable to SEM activities using approved methods, documented adjustments, and appropriate uncertainty checks. Data Quality: Identify missing, inconsistent, or anomalous utility and driver data before they affect model results or savings claims. Program Compliance: Apply the applicable utility and program measurement and verification protocols consistently across participating facilities. Actionable Insight: Translate model findings into useful feedback for SEM coaches, engineers, customers, and program managers. Timely Delivery: Maintain models and recurring reports on schedule while supporting accurate portfolio-level tracking and continuous improvement. 

Daily and Monthly Responsibilities

Assemble Analysis Data: Collect and organize utility bills, interval meter data, production records, weather data, operating schedules, occupancy, and other drivers relevant to each facility. Validate Data Quality: Check units, time stamps, meter coverage, missing periods, duplicate records, outliers, and changes in operations; document corrections and unresolved limitations. Develop Regression Models: Select appropriate baseline periods and independent variables; build and test facility-level models using suitable statistical tools and program-approved methods. Evaluate Model Performance: Review residuals, explanatory power, bias, error metrics, and the plausibility of coefficients; investigate poor model fit and avoid unsupported savings conclusions. Calculate SEM Savings: Compare observed reporting-period energy use with modeled baseline consumption adjusted to reporting-period conditions; document formulas, inputs, and results. Address Facility Changes: Assess whether equipment, production, schedules, occupancy, or other non-routine changes require model revisions or documented adjustments under program rules. Support Measurement and Verification: Prepare model files, data dictionaries, calculation workbooks, charts, and narratives for internal review, utility reporting, and evaluator requests. Collaborate with Program Teams: Work with SEM coaches and engineers to understand facility operations, validate model drivers, investigate unexpected trends, and interpret results. Communicate Findings: Present baselines, performance trends, savings estimates, assumptions, and uncertainty in concise reports and visualizations suited to the intended audience. Maintain Portfolio Tracking: Update recurring analyses, track analysis status and due dates, reconcile facility results to program reporting, and escalate data or modeling risks. Improve Analytical Practices: Help refine templates, quality checks, documentation standards, and repeatable workflows across SEM programs. 

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, statistics, mathematics, data science, economics, physics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience. Regression Analysis: Demonstrated ability to develop, interpret, and validate multivariable regression models using real-world time-series or operational data. Data Analysis Tools: Strong Excel skills and proficiency with at least one analytical environment such as R, Python, SQL, or a comparable statistical tool. Analytical Judgment: Ability to assess model fit, data quality, variable selection, outliers, seasonality, and uncertainty without relying solely on automated outputs. Technical Documentation: Ability to maintain transparent calculations and explain methods, assumptions, adjustments, and results clearly in writing. Collaboration: Ability to work with engineers, customer-facing teams, and program managers to understand the operational context behind the data. Organization: Ability to manage analyses for multiple facilities and programs, maintain version control, and meet recurring reporting deadlines. 

Preferred Qualifications

SEM Experience: Experience developing energy baselines or calculating savings for strategic energy management, industrial energy management, or related utility programs. Measurement and Verification: Familiarity with whole-facility measurement and verification, normalized metered energy consumption approaches, IPMVP Option C, or utility-specific SEM protocols. Energy Data: Experience working with utility interval data, billing data, weather normalization, industrial production data, or building management system trends. Statistical Methods: Experience evaluating model bias, normalized mean bias error, coefficient of variation of root mean squared error, confidence intervals, or comparable model quality measures where appropriate. Energy Systems: Familiarity with commercial or industrial energy systems and common factors that influence facility energy consumption. Program Markets: Experience supporting ComEd, PECO, NYSEG, or other utility energy efficiency programs. 

WE OFFER

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. ($60k-$75k)Performance-based bonus tied to individual and company performance. 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match. Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays. Professional development and training opportunities. A dynamic, inclusive work environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, and growth. 

Join us!

At EIP, your analysis will help organizations see whether changes in how they operate are producing measurable energy savings. You will bring statistical rigor and practical judgment to SEM programs across multiple utility markets.

Energy Infrastructure Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Note: This is a Chicago-based hybrid position. EIP generally requires four days per week in office when not traveling. Specific in-office requirements will be based on program needs.

EIP does not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement. This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations to leadership.

You will join our Private Capital practice in our New York office to work in teams and directly with our clients to help solve some of their most difficult problems. McKinsey’s Private Capital practice is the world’s leading advisor to the Private Equity and Principal Investor industry. We work with investors of all types: Private Equity firms, distressed debt/credit investors, real estate, and infrastructure firms, as well as the institutional investors these alternative investment managers serve, including pensions, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, and endowments. We serve these clients through the deal cycle, assisting with deal identification, due diligence, and portfolio company operational improvements, as well as on firm-level topics including strategy, governance, and operations.

You will be responsible for bringing strategic thinking to each client’s situation. This includes developing frameworks to analyze business problems using qualitative and quantitative approaches, working on financial benchmarking and business modeling to provide fact-based rationale for clients' strategic choices across organic and inorganic upside opportunities. Your work will also involve conducting extensive due diligence work, which may include collecting historical deal-related information, developing and executing a comprehensive work plan, reviewing contracts and policies, analyzing data, identifying risks, conducting competitor analysis, financial analysis, and valuation, and gathering a comprehensive set of data.

During your first few years with the firm, you will consult on multiple client engagements and work with several colleagues and clients across a range of industry areas.

You’ll receive strengths-based development and mentoring from colleagues. This will include a senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals. Additionally, you will have a professional development manager who manages your staffing based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Undergraduate degree or a master’s degree and 1+ years of full-time work experience after completing your undergraduate degree1+ years due diligence experience in a consulting firm, investment bank, or major corporationOutstanding record of academic achievementDemonstrated experience or strong interest in the investing industry, with a basic understanding of industry functioning, drivers, or key players based on work experience, internships, or your studiesProficiency in financial analysis, including financial statement analysis, financial modeling, and risk assessmentDemonstrated aptitude for analytics and excel fluency with exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, and ideally, exposure to market modellingIntellectual curiosity, creative thinking and problem-solving mindsetAdaptability and openness to collaborate in a flexible environmentSensitivity on social responsibility and ambition to have a real impact on clients and on our communitiesStrong record of leadership in an academic, professional or extracurricular settingLanguage fluency skills to communicate complex ideas in English effectively, both verbally and in writing

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

You will be a member of the Travel Intelligence team, a high-impact group dedicated to building the "intelligent core" of Capital One Travel. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of travel data into personalized, seamless experiences for our customers. Specifically, this role focuses on the Hotels domain, where you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for Search & Sort and Pricing Optimization. We operate in a "green-field" environment, moving from offline, historical data models to sophisticated, real-time Machine Learning solutions. As part of Travel Intelligence, you won't just be building models; you'll be partnering closely with Product and Engineering to define key metrics (like MOB and Reference Price coverage) and architecting the systems that determine what our customers see and what they pay. This is a unique opportunity to apply the 80:20 rule—starting with pragmatic, high-impact wins while simultaneously building the business case and technical roadmap for the future of ML at Capital One Travel.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 4 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 5 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 5 years’ experience with machine learning

Job Title: Experimentation Analyst

Location: New York

Company: BritBox International

Reporting to: Manager, Testing & Customer Insights

Contract Type: Full Time / Permanant

About Us

BBC Studios’ Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business brings premium content directly to North American audiences through two distinctive streaming brands: BritBox and BBC Select.

BritBox, the ultimate streaming destination for British TV. We offer an unparalleled collection of thoughtfully curated entertainment—cleverly crafted and full of the charm, wit, and heart that define British storytelling.

Born from the BBC, our mission is to bring authentic British stories to our audiences. Launched in 2017, we are a small but mighty streamer that punches above our weight—available on every major platform and even featured among the bright lights of Times Square—and we’re just getting started.

BBC Select is a documentary streaming service that has been successfully operating since February 2021. It has established itself as the third-largest documentary streaming service in the US. With plans to expand through original commissions, territorial premieres, and new distribution platforms, BBC Select continues to serve a highly engaged audience that values educational, high-quality content. The integration of BBC Select into the DTC organization presents a strong opportunity to leverage shared capabilities, insights, and expertise to accelerate growth and enhance overall customer experience.

If you’re passionate about entertainment, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to play a meaningful role in our growth journey, this is your opportunity to be part of a dynamic Direct-to-Consumer business within BBC Studios, bringing the very best of British TV to fans everywhere.

Job Purpose

As Experimentation Analyst, you will collaborate closely with multiple departments such as Marketing, Creative, UX and Product to design, execute, and monitor tests. Through testing, you’ll deliver improved results in areas such as paid media, key subscription metrics including trial-to-paid conversion, LTV and retention, and help ensure new launches and tactics are successful from the get-go.

Alongside this, you will help manage the day-to-day A/B testing workflow, from test intake through to results summaries and sharing learnings across the business. You will also communicate regularly with stakeholders to ensure tests are aligned, progress is visible, and insights are translated into clear actions.

This is an opportunity for a self-starter who can dig in and use both data-driven insights and testing techniques to drive growth within our company.

Responsibilities

Test Setup & Execution: Assist in designing and implementing A/B tests and multivariate tests for marketing campaigns, creative assets, and subscriber strategies in product/app, email, push etc.Project Management: Ensure all tests are tracked centrally, making all relevant updates to details and dates, proactively identifying conflicts and ensuring tests will start and end on agreed timelines.Monitoring & Reporting: Regularly monitor test performance, analyze results, and compile reports that detail findings and recommendations for future campaigns.Data Analysis: Utilize analytics tools to evaluate user behavior and conversion metrics, identifying trends and actionable insights to enhance marketing efforts.Collaboration: Work closely with the Senior Manager, marketing team, and creative team to ensure tests align with business goals and user needs.Subscriber Strategy Support: Contribute to the development of strategies aimed at attracting new subscribers and improving retention through data-driven insights.Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in testing and optimization, integrating new methodologies to improve testing processes.Documentation & Communication: Maintain clear documentation of testing protocols and communicate results effectively to stakeholders, ensuring alignment on strategic decisions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Data Science, or a related field.Previous experience in testing, optimization, or analytics, preferably in a digital or subscription-based environment.Understanding of key statistical concepts for hypothesis testing, including confidence intervals, p values, alpha, beta, standard deviation etc.Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (e.g., Optimizely) and marketing automation tools.Familiarity with analytics platforms such as GA4, Meta, etc.Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Google Analytics, SQL, Tableau).Excellent communication skills, able to present complex data insights in a clear and actionable manner.Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Familiarity with AI tools and desire to learn for workflow improvements, test analysis, build and ideation.Passion for data-driven decision-making and improving customer experiences.Bonus: HTML/CSS/JavaScript to directly set up tests in tools such as Optimizely.

Skills And Personal Attributes

Passionate about British TV and SVOD.Motivated by working in a fast-paced media environment.Natural project manager, able to manage self & others to complete tasks on time and communicate clear deliverables and expectations.Excited to pioneer and continually evolve a new platform for testing & optimization.Proven ability to translate analytics into actionable insights.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.We work flexibly at BritBox; to support new markets, some work may be conducted outside of US business hours to coordinate with territories in other time zones.This job spec is not exhaustive and may change from time to time in line with the evolving nature of a dynamic and growing business.

Salary Range: $85K base salary + competitive benefits + bonus potential

Please note that the salary range is intended to give as an indicator of the salaries that could be attributed to the breadth or experience for a given role. All candidates will be measured based on their level of experience.

Our Values

Our BritBox Global Values not only represent our culture but also ensure that we have principles that shape everything we do. Defined by our employees, they are not just words on a page, but the foundation of how we work together, every day.

Our values have been cascaded into specific behaviours, which are embedded into all of our people processes, including hiring, onboarding, performance evaluation and feedback.

We are proud of our values and seek to hire people who resonate with them

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

You will be a member of the Travel Intelligence team, a high-impact group dedicated to building the "intelligent core" of Capital One Travel. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of travel data into personalized, seamless experiences for our customers. Specifically, this role focuses on the Hotels domain, where you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for Search & Sort and Pricing Optimization. We operate in a "green-field" environment, moving from offline, historical data models to sophisticated, real-time Machine Learning solutions. As part of Travel Intelligence, you won't just be building models; you'll be partnering closely with Product and Engineering to define key metrics (like MOB and Reference Price coverage) and architecting the systems that determine what our customers see and what they pay. This is a unique opportunity to apply the 80:20 rule—starting with pragmatic, high-impact wins while simultaneously building the business case and technical roadmap for the future of ML at Capital One Travel.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 4 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 5 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 5 years’ experience with machine learning

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Background

Anchored in the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and in line with the priorities outlined in the UNDP Strategic Plan, the Regional Bureau for Arab States (RBAS) supports the Arab States region to achieve sustainable development by eradicating poverty in all its forms and dimensions, accelerating structural transformations for sustainable development, and building resilience to crises and shocks. Within this work, the Regional Bureau for Arab States responds to needs across development settings including Least Developed Countries, Middle Income Countries, Net Contributor Countries and countries affected by crisis, with a view to support the building of resilience, fight climate change, leverage the promise of innovation, and prioritize the advance of women, youth and vulnerable groups as part of its commitment to the principles of universality, equality and leaving no one behind in an increasing challenging regional context which has been further impacted by various crises.

RBAS supports partners in the region to develop integrated, transformative, and scalable solutions to tackle the interconnected challenges of poverty, vulnerability, inequality and exclusion, in ways that are economically, socially and environmentally sustainable. The team assists in enhancing prospects for inclusive growth, jobs and livelihoods at national and local levels, including through economic recovery and resilience-building in crisis and post crisis contexts, focusing on empowering women and youth, and advancing opportunities for the most vulnerable. It also supports research, policy, and program guidance around: macroeconomic stability, private and financial sectors, fiscal policy and public finance management, economic transformation, social protection, women economic empowerment, urban and digital economy, etc.

The intern will report to the Strategic Initiatives Advisor in RBAS New York and will support the work on policy and research, including the Arab Human Development Report (AHDR) and ongoing socio-economic analyses examining the implications of conflicts and other shocks for growth, employment, poverty, inequality and human development in the Arab States region.

Duties And Responsibilities

Research and analysis: Conducting data collection, desk reviews of existing research and literature on one or two of the areas that the inclusive growth team is currently working on (namely, macroeconomics, public finance management, social protection, informality, labor market, poverty and inequality, private sector development (including micro, small and medium enterprises), SDG financing).Policy Brief Development: Assist in the drafting and preparation of policy briefs, technical notes, and economic assessments tailored for regional stakeholders and decision-makers.Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Support the team by conducting quantitative data analysis using reliable sources and tools to identify and visualize regional economic trends.Event and Dialogue Support: Provide logistical and substantive support in organizing regional consultations, webinars, and other forums related to inclusive growth and economic development.Regional Monitoring: Regularly monitor and summarize macroeconomic indicators, ongoing socio-economic developments, and policy shifts across the Arab States region to inform the team's ongoing programmatic work.Knowledge Management: Assist in maintaining and updating internal databases, knowledge repositories, and community-of-practice platforms with the latest research and data findings.Assist in the development: of new or ongoing initiatives, including review of policy literature in respect to the subject to enhance UNDP programming in the relevant field within the Arab Region.Document good practices: Including cases studies, innovations and pilot models for wider dissemination and sharing.Concept notes: Prepare conceptual framework / concept notes on new areas of work or development challenges.

Competencies

Functional Competencies

Strong sense of collaborative work, excellent communication and interpersonal skills;Keen attention to detail;Proven record of interest and work in the development field;Excellent analytical and research skills using state of the art quantitative analytical tools such as STATA, R;Research experience;Interest in the Arab States region and possibly some background in researching the region;

Professionalism

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and judgment in applying technical expertise to resolve a wide range of complex issues/problems;Ability to negotiate and to influence others to reach agreement;Ability to work under pressure;Shows pride in work and in achievement;Demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter, especially economic development and resilience;Is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results;Is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns;Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges;Remains calm in stressful situations;Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work;Takes responsibility for incorporating the perspective of youth and ensuring the equal participation of young people as in all areas of work.

Communication

Speaks and writes clearly, concisely and effectively;Listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately;Asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication;Tailors language, tone, style and format to match audience;Demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.

Teamwork

Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise;Is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda;Supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position;Shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.

Planning & Organizing

Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies;Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required;Allocates appropriate amount of time and resource for completing work;Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning;Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary;Uses time efficiently.

Accountability

Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honor commitments;Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards;Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules;Supports subordinates, provide oversight and take responsibility for delegated assignments;Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.

Creativity

Actively seeks to improve program or services;Offers new and different options to solve problems or meet client needs;Promotes and persuades others to consider new ideas;Takes calculated risks on new and unusual ideas;Thinks “outside the box”;Takes an interest in new ideas and new ways of doing things;Not bound by current thinking or traditional approaches.

Technological Awareness

Keeps abreast of available technology;Understands applicability and limitation of technology to the work of the office;Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks;Shows willingness to learn new technology.

Education

Required Skills and Experience

Applicants to the UNDP internship programme must at the time of application meet one of the following requirements:

 Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as a master’s programme, or higher) in subjects relevant to the work of Inclusive Growth Team (economics, development studies, public policy, international development and related fields).  Be enrolled in the final academic year of a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in subjects mentioned under (1) above.  Have recently graduated with a university degree (as defined in (1) and (2) above) and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation.  Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional traineeship program and undertake the internship as part of this program. 

Experience

Experience with quantitative data analysis using software like R, Stata, or Python is a strong asset.Demonstrated ability to work well both independently and within a multicultural team.Good command of information and communication technology.

Languages

Fluency in English (both oral and written) is required. Arabic and French language skills would be an asset but not necessary for the assignment.

Stipend

Where an intern is not financially supported by any institution or programme, such as a university, government, foundation or scholarship programme, a stipend intended to help cover basic daily expenses related to the internship, such as meals and transportation at the duty station, must be paid by the receiving office.The monthly amount of the stipend will be determined for each duty station based on the stipend rates published yearly by the OHR Policy and Compensation Unit. The stipend will be paid on a monthly basis and part-time internship arrangements are prorated accordingly.Where an intern is financially supported by an institution, government or third party, UNDP will, subject to the rules of such institution, government or third party, pay the intern the difference, if any, between the external financial support provided and the applicable UNDP stipend.No other payments of any kind will be made to an intern by the office in connection with an internship agreement.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

Our client, a modern media and entertainment organization with a growing portfolio of consumer-facing brands across linear, streaming, and digital platforms, is seeking a Strategic Analytics Analyst for a 3-month contract in New York, NY (hybrid).
