Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

Position Summary

This role is a commercial innovation strategy and capability leadership position responsible for translating Nestlé USA innovation priorities into practical, division-level action. The Senior Manager partners across brands, categories, Commercial Development, Sales, Finance, Consumer Insights & Foresight, Digital, R&D, TAG (Technical Application Group), and external partners to build innovation strategy, stronger rolling pipelines, embed Innovation the Nestlé Way, improve portfolio governance and performance visibility, and accelerate scalable, consumer-led innovation. The role combines strategic thought leadership with hands-on execution, helping teams move from ambition to prioritized opportunities, robust concepts, and disciplined commercialization.

Primary Responsibilities

Innovation Strategy and Strategic Pipeline Development

Partner with division and Product Experience (PX) teams to translate Business Strategy and Brand priorities into long-term innovation strategy with actionable, rolling three-year pipeline plans.Lead innovation-needs and opportunity assessments, including Brand Building the Nestle Way alignment, to identify gaps, clarify choices, and strengthen future growth platforms.Integrate Consumer Insights & Foresight perspectives into strategy, opportunity framing, concept development, and pipeline decisions.

Innovation Process, Capability Building, and Toolkits

Lead the practical adoption of Innovation the Nestlé Way, including the FEI process, frameworks, best practices, and connections to commercialization and stage gate governance.Diagnose capability and process needs across divisions and develop customized coaching, workshops, playbooks, and toolkits based on business priorities.Coach brand and cross-functional teams through opportunity framing, prioritization, concept development, experimentation, and decision-making.Partner with Learning & Development and Marketing Transformation teams to embed innovation capability into sustainable ways of working.

Portfolio Governance, Performance, and Accountability

Cross-Functional Integration and Commercialization

Requirements

rows.descriptionText:
When you become a member of Team DHCF (Department of Health Care Finance), the state Medicaid agency for the District of Columbia, you join our "Mission Possible!" We work every day, in concert with various District government agencies, to streamline access to comprehensive, affordable, and quality healthcare services for District residents. Whatever your position within our agency, you will positively impact beneficiaries, their families, and their future! We invite you to bring your skills, your experience and your passion to a job that makes a difference!

Job Summary

This position is located within the Department of Health Care Finance (DHCF), Health Care Delivery Management Administration (HCDMA), Division of Quality and Health Outcomes. This position has responsibility for ensuring quality and performance improvement principles and practices pervade all the components and activities that impact on the delivery and outcomes of healthcare services to patients served by the District's Medicaid, CHIP and Fee for Service programs.

Duties And Responsibilities

Plans, develops, implements, manages, and evaluates health plan or provider monitoring to assess compliance with structural and operational quality standards, with a particular focus on long-term services and supports (LTSS) received in both institutional and community settings. Assures that provider or health plan quality requirements are met, and that provider or health plan performance meets Medicaid standards. Develops, manages, and evaluates short term and long-range initiatives to measure and improve the quality of health services delivered through DHCF programs. Develops quality measurement and improvement initiatives in collaboration with organizational units within DHCF responsible for supporting and/or administering certain programs areas. These may include programs for families and children, acute programs, program integrity, and policy and research. Collaborates with other District agencies responsible for caring for these populations as well as organizations providing health care services, advocacy organizations, and other interested parties.

Analyzes and recommends changes to improve quality measurement and/or improvement projects, protocols, strategies, and initiatives proposed, planned, or undertaken by health care providers, contractors to DHCF, or other parties. Plans, develops, implements, manages, or evaluates studies on health care quality that are focused on particular aspects of clinical and non-clinical services. This may include use of contractors to perform activities such as the, assessment of quality assessment and performance improvement projects, and the conduct and analysis of consumer and/or provider surveys. Develops statistical and narrative reports of health plan and provider progress towards improving quality and recommends actions to be taken to improve quality, where appropriate. Monitors reports of events that threaten patient safety. Assesses and evaluates reports in order to elicit an appropriate and timely response from relevant District agencies.

Qualifications And Education

Specialized Experience – Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and this is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. None

The work is performed in an adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated office environment

rows.title: Research Technician
rows.descriptionText:
Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Research Technician supports NIH-funded research in the laboratory of Dr. Patrick Forcelli, which studies the brain circuits that control seizures and the long-term effects of early-life exposure to anti-seizure and psychiatric medications on brain development and behavior. The technician carries out in vivo experiments in rodents, performs histological processing and microscopy, manages and analyzes experimental data, and keeps the laboratory, animal colony, and regulatory records running smoothly so that the lab’s research projects progress on schedule.

Additional Duties, Include But Are Not Limited To

Conducting in vivo rodent experiments, including drug administration, behavioral testing, stereotaxic surgery, and EEG/seizure monitoring.Processing brain tissue for histology and immunohistochemistry, and acquiring and quantifying microscope images.Organizing, curating, and analyzing experimental data (behavior, EEG, histology) and preparing summaries for the PI and lab members.Managing breeding colonies and maintaining animal-use records in compliance with IACUC protocols.Ordering supplies, reconciling charges, maintaining equipment, and supporting general laboratory operations.

Work Interactions

The Research Technician works within the Forcelli Laboratory in the Department of Pharmacology & Physiology and reports directly to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Patrick Forcelli, Professor and Chair. The technician works day to day with the lab’s postdoctoral fellows, Ph.D. students, and undergraduate researchers, and interacts with Department of Comparative Medicine (vivarium) staff, core facilities, and departmental administrative staff for purchasing and grant administration. This position has no direct reports. By enabling rigorous, reproducible research on epilepsy and developmental neuropharmacology, the position advances Georgetown University’s mission of research, education, and service to improve human health.

Requirements And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in neuroscience, biology, psychology, pharmacology, or a related field, and at least one year of hands-on laboratory research experience (undergraduate research experience qualifies)Must be able to work with live animals (rodents), follow detailed written protocols, and keep accurate records.

Preferred

Experience with rodent handling, dosing, behavioral testing, or stereotaxic surgery; experience with histology, immunohistochemistry, and fluorescence microscopy; familiarity with EEG or electrophysiological data; working knowledge of data analysis software (e.g., GraphPad Prism, ImageJ/FIJI, MATLAB, Python, or R); and prior completion of IACUC/CITI animal research training.

rows.title: Digital Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Echelon Insights is hiring a Digital Research Analyst to research, monitor, and measure digital conversation, engagement, and influence across a wide range of issues globally, supporting our corporate, nonprofit, and political clients. Analysts will also be exposed to the rest of the work Echelon does, including survey research and data analytics/modeling, assisting on these projects as necessary.

Echelon Insights is a right-of-center decision strategy firm that blends innovative survey research techniques with data science and digital analytics to help our clients win the battle for hearts and minds. The work environment is fast-paced and growth-oriented, with all team members taking ownership for client success. Echelon Insights is headquartered in historic Old Town Alexandria, Virginia and offers competitive benefits, including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) plans.

Main Responsibilities

rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

rows.title: Intermediate Applied Operations Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutionsFrame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analysesPresent results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifactsWork independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain expertsWork successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problemsBe willing to adapt and learnDemonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related fieldPreference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomesFamiliarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:

Position themselves for value-based care delivery.Align hospitals and physician organizations.Strengthen financial performance.Enhance clinical programs.Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.

Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Data Analyst

As a senior data analyst, you will support the firm’s client delivery and business development efforts, working with consultants and senior leaders to manage large datasets, aggregate internal and external data, develop scalable models and other analyses, and support data visualization and presentation sets. In addition, the analyst will work directly with our internal support teams (IT, business development, and L&D) and associated vendors for data management and IT solutions and will assist with a range of innovative analytic opportunities. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed.

Your Responsibilities May Include

Gather and synthesize data from various sources (e.g., national surveys, proprietary research, client interviews, industries, markets).Prepare analyses related to hospital inpatient databases and provider claims data.Build flexible, dynamic, and scalable financial and operational models to forecast trends, preparing scenarios for consulting efforts related to delivery and business development (e.g., strategic planning, operational improvement, market assessments).Enhance existing models and capabilities built using SQL, primarily, with some use of Python or R in certain models or scenarios.Perform complex analyses on big data, including cleaning, preparing, and interpreting.Identify and execute analyses in response to consultant business intelligence inquiries.Build relational databases using a Microsoft SQL Server or Fabric.Communicate market insights to pursuit teams, and support business development efforts.Configure, maintain, and build flexible reports, queries, and visuals within the Power BI environment and the production and development environments of related databases.Research, test, and implement solutions in Power BI.Partner with various consulting units (Strategy & Enterprise Growth, Payer Strategy & Contracting, Health System Performance, and Medical Group Optimization) to gather requirements related to data analytics.Develop, configure, and maintain interfaces to exchange data among Power BI, SQL databases, and other cloud-based applications.Create and maintain analytical support documentation and operating procedures.Develop new and innovative methodologies and approaches.Contribute to internal education and learning opportunities for consultants and operations members for the Analytics Hub and analytics in general, and support education about ECG’s use cases related to analytics.Assist the vice president of data analytics and AI in developing analytics and data strategy to support data analytics capabilities at the firm.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industryA bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math5+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics, including analyzing clinical, operational, financial, or population health dataExperience in healthcare consulting, healthcare technology, or working for a hospital or health system, using data to deliver actionable insights and recommendationsStrong proficiency in data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and translating complex data into actionable business insightsExperience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHRs, patient outcomes, quality metrics, or value-based care programs is highly preferredAdvanced skills in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); experience with Python, R, Databricks, or Azure is a plusProficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPointStrong written and verbal communication skillsExcellent organizational skills

Job Locations

Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, DCOther location: Boston

Schedule

Full time/exempt

What You Can Expect Of Us

To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in.

The estimated base salary range for this job is $100000.00 - $130000.00 annually. It represents a good faith estimate of the range that ECG reasonably expects to pay at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to years of experience, special skills, and market changes. This job is eligible to participate in ECG’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects ECG’s pay-for-performance philosophy. The job is also eligible to participate in ECG’s benefit plans, which include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) matching program, unlimited PTO, and other wellness programs.

Apply now and make an impact for years to come.

To begin the recruitment process, please submit your resume via our career site at https://careers.ecgmc.com.

ECG provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, disability, pregnancy, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We participate in E-Verify as part of our onboarding process. Having the permanent legal right to work in the United States is a condition of employment. rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - US Card (Applied GenAI)
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:

The Servicing Intelligence team delivers data science solutions to capture value from unstructured, multi-modal data sources — text, image, and audio data. We operate as an applied data science team, building with open source generative AI models and tooling, but prioritizing application over research to scale the adoption of AI with in-market solutions.

You will sit on a team of data scientists that collaborates daily with product, tech, and business teams to embed AI in varied domains, including frontline agent servicing, back office document processing, AI for regulatory compliance, and overall customer experience. Your work will apply generative AI on millions of inputs, spanning from extracting key information from unstructured documents to analyzing call transcripts to resolve the root cause of customer friction.

As a core member of the team, you will be the driving force to create best-in-class products and experiences powered by the latest emerging generative AI technologies.

Role Description:

In this role, you will:

Apply expertise in unstructured data (text, image) to harness the power of open source large language models (LLMs) and visual language models (VLMs)Leverage a broad stack of technologies — LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Weights and Biases Weave, Hugging Face, PyTorch, AWS, and more — to automate workflows using huge volumes of text and vision dataBuild machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers. Assessing GenAI or LLM-Powered application architectures in production, including best practices for Generative AI development and deployments. Define requirements for AI observability, focusing on the traceability of autonomous decisions and comprehensive system audit trails. Evaluate the dynamic behavior of AI systems and oversee the development of key continuous monitoring controls and testing, ensuring that non-deterministic outputs and autonomous actions remain within risk appetite. Get into the weeds of internal business processes and data operations by guiding annotators to curate high quality, consistent datasets for model training, evaluation, and ongoing AI monitoring. Collaborate on a team of data scientists through all phases of project development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, implementation, and maintenance. Interact with a variety of internal stakeholders to ensure the alignment of data science solutions with business outcomes. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

rows.title: Temporary Content Analysis/Research Data Coders
rows.descriptionText:
Organization Overview

Pew Research Center is a nonpartisan fact tank that informs the public about the issues, attitudes and trends shaping the world. It conducts public opinion polling, demographic research, media content analysis and other empirical social science research in the areas of U.S. politics and policy views; media and journalism; internet and technology; science and society; religion and public life; race and ethnicity; global attitudes and U.S. social and demographic trends. Pew Research Center does not take policy positions. It is a subsidiary of The Pew Charitable Trusts. The Center’s work is carried out by a staff of about 180.

Position Summary

Pew Research Center’s News and Information team is seeking temporary Content Analysis/Research Data Coders to support research projects examining the online information environment, including online video content.

These temporary full-time positions will run for a 16-week period beginning January 19, 2027 (with the possibility of a 4-week extension). Due to the nature of the work, candidates must be able to commit to 37.5 hours per week during regular business hours. Positions are paid at a rate of $18.50 per hour.

In this role, Content Analysis/Research Data Coders will research and code information as part of efforts to understand how people use and get news on different social media sites. The work supports Pew Research Center’s efforts to study Americans’ news habits and attitudes and changes in the news and information environment. Coders will apply content analysis research methods and review social media content and accounts as well as participate in quality-control activities.

Primary Responsibilities

Working under direction, Coders will have the following duties:

Coding & Data Entry

Apply Pew Research Center’s codebook to code content following Pew Research Center's methodology.Discuss research findings and provide input on shaping the coding guidelines and process.Enter codes and supporting evidence into a database.Compare coding with partners to spot discrepancies and reconcile differences appropriately, in consultation with researchers.

Education/Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Recent graduate or current student (must have completed at least 2 years of college) with an interest in news and information, social media, and/or other topics relevant to the study of video news consumption and content analysis of news.Previous coding (content analysis) experience, qualitative research experience, or work in similar research projects is an advantage, but not required.Basic familiarity with Excel is required.Detail oriented with exacting standards to maintain accuracy and impartiality in all work products.Ability to work well in a team setting.Ability to take instructions and follow through well.Ability to work diligently under deadlines.Ability to communicate clearly in a remote work environment, including documenting coding notes, questions and decisions appropriately and clearly.Ability to read through lengthy reports and code relevant information.

Requirements

This is a full-time temporary position located in Washington, DC. Candidates must reside in the following states for the duration of employment (DC, MD, VA). Coders have the option to work in the office or remotely and must be available during established business hours.

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Salary: $18.50 per hour

rows.title: Digital Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Echelon Insights is hiring a Digital Research Analyst to research, monitor, and measure digital conversation, engagement, and influence across a wide range of issues globally, supporting our corporate, nonprofit, and political clients. Analysts will produce a steady stream of daily and weekly reports that will go directly to clients, helping them make informed, data-driven decisions. In our digital analytics practice, we don't just count mentions. We apply methodological rigor and subject matter expertise to surface need-to-know insights on a real time basis. Analysts will also be exposed to the rest of the work Echelon does, including survey research and data analytics/modeling, assisting on these projects as necessary.

Echelon Insights is a right-of-center decision strategy firm that blends innovative survey research techniques with data science and digital analytics to help our clients win the battle for hearts and minds. The work environment is fast-paced and growth-oriented, with all team members taking ownership for client success. Echelon Insights is headquartered in historic Old Town Alexandria, Virginia and offers competitive benefits, including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) plans.

Main Responsibilities

Producing daily, weekly, and deep-dive reports summarizing online conversation surrounding key client issuesConduct planning for deep-dive, longer-term research projects, pinpointing the right research questions to answer, identifying data sources and mapping out analytical methodsProvide rapid response monitoring in crisis / breaking news situationsCoordinate data collection from Echelon or third party monitoring tools, including coding of open-ended dataAdapt rapidly to changing client needs, with the ability to deploy a wide range of possible analytical tools, understanding that no two clients or reports are the sameBuild custom dashboards in Tableau or other data visualization softwareContinually stay on top of the social media monitoring and digital analytics landscape, proactively implementing new tools and approachesThink critically about how to best measure, analyze, and report on large digital data sets

Requirements

2+ years experience at an agency, survey research firm, or at an organization where your primary job responsibility was in media monitoring or digital analyticsA strong interest in the news, politics, and public policy, with the ability to quickly get up to speed on new topics and issuesExceptionally productive and efficient, with a strong work ethicData-driven and a strong desire to work with numbersStrong written and verbal communication skillsAbility to juggle and prioritize multiple projectsExcellent organizational skills and attention to detailPast experience with social and traditional media monitoring software (Meltwater, Sysomos, Brandwatch, Cision, Crimson Hexagon, NetBase, etc.)Strong aptitude for data manipulation using Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.), with experience in Tableau, Alteryx, R, or MySQL a plusConversant in the field with the ability to proactively suggest different data collection strategies (third party subscription tools, scraping, APIs, etc.)Coordinate third party vendors including technology tools and translatorsA strong interest in survey research, with past experience in the field a plusProficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Apps, and KeynoteMultilingual with English and proficiency in another language is a plus

Salary: $60,000-75,000

Prior applicants are encouraged to reapply

Echelon Insights provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, veteran status, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. This application does not constitute a guarantee or offer of employment.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Reingold

Reingold is a full-service marketing and creative firm in Alexandria, VA. For more than 40 years, we’ve been driven by a simple mission: to help organizations, whether in the government, nonprofit, or business sector, as they strive to make the world a better place. We hire top-notch talent to develop and launch compelling, inventive communications campaigns, leveraging the latest technology and digital media strategies that enable our clients to meet their audiences where they are.

We’re proud to say we’ve built a team of curious, passionate pros — from marketers and tech wizards to designers and strategists — who love what they do and bring their A-game every day. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We believe great ideas come from collaboration, humor, and a little bit of fun along the way.

When you work at Reingold, you get more than a job, you get a community. We offer competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, a dynamic hybrid work environment, a vibrant workplace and growth opportunities in a variety of specialty areas. That means when we find great people (and they find us), they stick around for the long term.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a specialist to build the reporting our client sees and to support the Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) work behind it. Most of your time will be spent in Snowflake, writing the SQL that powers dashboards, building and maintaining dashboard views, and assembling the recurring reports that go to the client. The rest will be hands-on AEP configuration tasks to support Senior AEP Specialists, with opportunity to contribute to platform design and standards. It’s a role with room to grow: you’ll get real depth in a modern customer data and reporting stack while being supported by a senior team. The work involves sensitive and personally identifiable information, so the privacy standards set for the engagement must be practiced in everything you touch.

This is a hybrid role, requiring at least two days per week on site at Reingold’s headquarters in Alexandria, VA.

Essential Functions

Here’s the work you’ll do: 

Build and maintain client-facing dashboards in Snowflake, working from the designs, metric definitions, and specifications provided by the team to help the client measure progress against their business goals. Write, test, and maintain the SQL behind the reporting layer, including queries, views, and transformations in Snowflake that feed dashboards and recurring reports, and tune them for performance as data volumes grow. Maintain the reporting datasets in Snowflake that hold profile, audience, and engagement data from AEP: monitor scheduled refreshes, watch for gaps or late-arriving data, and flag issues to the team. Assemble recurring and ad hoc client reports, which includes pulling and organizing the numbers, building the charts and tables, reconciling them against source data, and preparing drafts for senior review. Run data quality checks between AEP and Snowflake, investigate discrepancies in counts and metrics, and document what you find for the team. Carry out assigned Adobe Experience Platform configuration tasks to written specifications by creating and updating datasets and XDM schema fields, building audience segments, and setting up source connections and destinations with guidance from senior team members. Assist with testing and monitoring the data flows between AEP and Snowflake, confirming that audiences activate as expected and that data lands in Snowflake on schedule. Practice the privacy standards defined for the engagement in every task by applying data usage labels and governance policies as specified, honoring consent and access rules, and minimizing exposure of PII. This role will be expected to escalate anything that looks out of step with those standards to the team. Document queries, views, dashboard logic, and reporting procedures, and keep run books and trackers current for the team and the client. 

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the person in this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time.

This role is a good fit for someone with these qualifications, experience and skills: 

Required Qualifications

2+ years of professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, marketing technology, or web developmentSQL skills and hands-on experience querying a cloud data warehouse. Snowflake is preferred, but experience with BigQuery, Redshift, or another cloud warehouse platform is welcomeDemonstrated experience building dashboards, reports, or data visualizations that non-technical stakeholders rely on, and a good instinct for presenting numbers clearlyPossess the level of attention to detail required to reconcile and QA data across systems and to catch a number that doesn’t look right before a client doesExposure to Adobe Experience Platform or a comparable enterprise customer data platform, and a willingness to execute configuration work to standards and specifications set by othersA working understanding of PII handling and data privacy basics, including consent and access control, and the discipline to follow established standardsExcellent oral and written communications skills, and the drive for results that leads you to ask questions and flag issues earlyA bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, computer science, math, or a similar field (or equivalent work experience)Ability to obtain a U.S. government clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schemas, audience segmentation, or destination setup. Hands-on Snowflake experience, and any exposure to Snowpark, Snowpark Container Services, or containerized application deployment. Working proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and React, particularly for data-driven interfaces. Experience with charting and visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3, Highcharts, or Plotly. Familiarity with Python and/or dbt for transformation and pipeline work. Adobe certification in Experience Platform (Business Practitioner or Developer), or coursework and training toward one. Exposure to website data collection and tag management (Adobe Launch/Data Collection, Tealium IQ, Google Tag Manager), or to adjacent platforms such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, or Adobe Analytics/CJA. Experience in a client-services or agency setting, or with government, public sector, or nonprofit clients handling sensitive data. 

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position will not have direct reports but will be expected to mentor junior teammates and lead by example and influence. This role reports to the Director, Customer Data & Marketing Technology, and receives day-to-day direction from senior members of the engagement team.

Work environment and physical requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Additional Information:   

The base salary range of $64,400 to $96,600 represents the low and high of the company’s pay range for this position. The budgeted starting salary is in the lower half of the base salary range. Individual compensation will vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and business needs. Full-time employees are eligible for comprehensive health and wellness benefits, 401(k) employer contributions and matching, and other benefits.   

Reingold is dedicated to providing equal opportunity for individuals of all abilities. If you require assistance or need accommodation at any stage of the application process because of a disability or medical condition, please feel free to email careers@reingold.com or contact a member of the People & Experience team at 202-333-0400. 

Reingold has a policy of maintaining a workplace free of drugs and alcohol. For access to the full policy, which is part of the Reingold Employee Handbook, email careers@reingold.com. Reingold ensures a safe, healthy, and productive work environment for its employees and others. All applicants are advised that full compliance with this policy is a condition of employment at Reingold. 

Applicants must have authorization to work for any employer in the United States. We are currently unable to sponsor or to take over sponsorship of an employment visa. Candidates for this position must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. 

Reingold is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We invite applications from all interested individuals including veterans and persons with disabilities.

Overview

Job Description:

Joining GDIT will improve outcomes for our veterans. You will support the Department of Veterans Affairs with a veteran-first vision to transform the Veterans' benefits administration with greater visibility into claims processing. Together, we're building a future of fast, transparent claims and empowered teams, striving for a zero backlog, and directly supporting veterans to make a real impact on the lives of those who served. This high-impact solution accelerates the delivery of benefits to veterans and their families.

Responsibilities

The role of the journey level Data Scientist is to lead the analysis of programmatic and technical data as it is collected from various program and/or project offices. Work closely with the multi-network data management specialist to structure, maintain, and ensure the integrity of large, complex datasets. Analyze data against predetermined metrics to assess sustainment performance, readiness, and capability gaps. Apply artificial intelligence and machine learning models (e.g., CAPRA, GenAI) to support gap analyses and business case analyses. Develop and refine prompts to optimize the performance and relevance of AI-generated outputs for project needs. Build and validate predictive models to forecast sustainment outcomes, readiness trends, and resource requirements. Create clear, concise data visualizations and summaries to communicate findings to engineers, logisticians, and program managers. Produce technical reports and actionable data summaries that support decision-making and project objectives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including systems engineers, logisticians, and program managers, to ensure data-driven insights are actionable and aligned with project goals.

 Direct experience supporting ACAT-level programs. Advanced degree in a relevant discipline. Direct experience working with defense, aerospace, or government programmatic/technical data. Experience with Python, R, SQL, or similar languages for data manipulation and analysis. Experience automating data workflows and processes using scripting or workflow automation tools.

ACE Group is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business that provides expertise in the operational application of current and future airborne weapons systems, with an emphasis on their lethality and survivability in the Battlespace. rows.title: Intermediate Applied Operations Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutionsFrame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analysesPresent results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifactsWork independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain expertsWork successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires 4 days a week on site

Secret

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret

Onsite

rows.title: Junior Data Engineer (SQL)
rows.descriptionText:
Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will build and maintain the queries, stored procedures, and views that make a federal agency's enterprise data platform function. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first assignment

In Your First Assignment, a Senior Developer Will Guide You As You Take On Your Assigned Components. Depending On The Assignment, You May

Build and maintain Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible).Work with data from Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3).Contribute to logical data models and database-design decisions within the established platform architecture, with reviews that explain what to change and why.Build reliable data loads from S3, tune queries with guidance, and work within governed access.

Over time, you will grow toward responsibility for physical design. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

1+ years of data engineering, database development, software development, or comparable practical experienceBachelor's degreeWorking knowledge of SQL, stored procedures, and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible)Familiarity with Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3)Query tuning with guidance from a senior developerExposure to extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) patterns and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data servicesAwareness of data security controls, including encryption, access management, and auditingBasic exposure to loading data from S3 into the platform stores and to Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC)Introductory familiarity with logical data modeling and the ability to contribute to database-design decisions within an established platform architectureProficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

An entry-level AWS certification, such as Cloud Practitioner, or the interest in earning oneExposure to query blocking, locking, and deadlocksInterest in cloud-native application support in AWS using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practicesExposure to physical design, including Aurora and DynamoDB schema and index design, or the motivation to grow into itFederal information technology or high-volume transaction experienceInterest in artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted developer tooling

Who You Are

You care about getting data right and want a career in data engineering and databases. You ask for help when you need it and put feedback to use quickly. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

A foundation in SQL and relational databases, with working knowledge of stored procedures and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible) and a desire to deepen it across DynamoDB and S3.Practical habits in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, applied with guidance and improved on feedback.Clear communication about what you have finished, what is blocking you, and where you need support.Careful execution in work where accuracy and auditability are essential.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments with onboarding, sponsored training, and professional development.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Organization

U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)

How To Apply

To submit your application, scroll to the bottom of this opportunity and click APPLY.

A Complete Application Consists Of

An applicationTranscripts – Click here for detailed information about acceptable transcriptsA current resume/CV, including academic history, employment history, relevant experiences, and publication listOne educational or professional recommendation

All documents must be in English or include an official English translation.

If you have questions, send an email to ORISE.FDA.CDRH@orau.org. Please include the reference code for this opportunity in your email.

Connect with ORISE...on the GO! Download the new ORISE GO mobile app in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store to help you stay engaged, connected, and informed during your ORISE experience and beyond!

Application Deadline

9/30/2027 3:00:00 PM Eastern Time Zone

Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: A postdoctoral research opportunity is available in the Division of Biology, Chemistry and Materials Science (DBCMS) within the Office of Science and Engineering Labs (OSEL) at the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) located in Silver Spring, Maryland.

Research Project(s): The objective of the project is to develop a web-based application that will facilitate biocompatibility evaluation of medical devices by streamlining extractable studies. We will use mass spectrometry data generated from medical device materials under different extraction conditions in conjunction with physics- based modeling to develop the web-based tool.

Learning Objectives: As a postdoctoral fellow you will:

Gain expertise in chemical extractable and leachable studies for medical devices through performing experiments, analyzing data, and interpreting results.Learn how to develop and implement varied research methodologies.Gain expertise in analytical methods including, GC-MS and LC-MS.Learn how to present to a wide scientific audience.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Nameera Wegner (nameera.wegner@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: 2026. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The appointment is full time.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens, Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR), and foreign nationals. Non-U.S. citizen applicants should refer to the Guidelines for Non-U.S. Citizens Details page of the program website for information about the valid immigration statuses that are acceptable for program participation.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

Completion of a successful background investigation by the Office of Personnel Management is required for an applicant to be on-boarded at FDA. OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

FDA Ethics Requirements

If an ORISE Fellow, to include their spouse and minor children, reports what is identified as a Significantly Regulated Organization (SRO) or prohibited investment fund financial interest in any amount, or a relationship with an SRO, except for spousal employment with an SRO, and the individual will not voluntarily divest the financial interest or terminate the relationship, then the individual is not placed at FDA. For additional requirements, see FDA Ethics for Nonemployee Scientists.

Education

FDA requires ORISE participants to read and sign their FDA Education and Training Agreement within 30 days of his/her start date, setting forth the conditions and expectations for his/her educational appointment at the agency. This agreement covers such topics as the following:

Non-employee nature of the ORISE appointment;Prohibition on ORISE Fellows performing inherently governmental functions;Obligation of ORISE Fellows to convey all necessary rights to the FDA regarding intellectual property conceived or first reduced to practice during their fellowship;The fact that research materials and laboratory notebooks are the property of the FDA;ORISE fellow’s obligation to protect and not to further disclose or use non-public information.

Qualifications

The qualified candidate should be currently pursuing or have received a doctoral degree in a relevant field (e.g., biology, microbiology, biochemistry, chemistry, computer science), with completion by May 31, 2026. Degree must have been received within the past five years.
