About The Job

Job Summary

The Specialty Territory Manager plans, develops, and manages the execution of commercial initiatives to attain or exceed sales targets established by the management team.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position

Achieve 100% of monthly, quarterly, annual sales plan. Plan and develop the market for our existing and new products in accordance with company goals and objectives; optimize available selling tools (marketing collateral, product brochure, trunk stock, demo product, iPad videos, etc.). Drive demand for products by Attaining Hospital Formulary approvals Gaining exposure to Health Care Providers and driving brand preference and loyalty . Driving prescriptions, and Discharge Orders. Community Awareness (events). Partnership Development (Distribution, manufacturing, home care) . Service – sampling, and one-by-one strategy . Ongoing technical training and support to customers (In-Services). Competent contact person for hospital management, purchasing department and hospital staff. Analyze and report to your manager and/or others (weekly & monthly) the market and business feedback by using all available support tools (email, iPad, company laptop). 

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Effectively handle lifting of various objects weighing up to 12 pounds.  While performing the essential functions of the job, the employee will be required to bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb stairs.  This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods. The employee will work in a home-office environment and travel to medical offices, clinics, hospitals, and other meeting locations. The role requires up to 90% field travel throughout the assigned territory, including up to 50% overnight travel. 

The salary range for this position is $74,900-135,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Business, Sales, Marketing, Nutrition, or related field. A minimum of 1-8 years of recent sales or equivalent related work experience, aligned with the level of the role. Registered Dietitian preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strategic thinking and problem solving . Strong interpersonal and communication skills . Negotiation and analytic skills . Possess a proactive attitude, initiative, and drive to learn. Highly organized with the ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work efficiently. Must possess computer skills with a keen understanding of business software such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, email, and calendar. Be flexible and embrace change with a growing and evolving company. 

About Us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Summary:

We’ve brought together Division FP&A, One Ops FP&A, and Corporate Decision Support together into one connected, centrally governed organization — now simply called FP&A — built on three pillars: Business Co-Piloting, Central FP&A, and Digital Finance.

The Senior Finance Analyst position is a critical role within Central FP&A, specifically supporting the One Ops organization. You will be jumping onto a team that is transforming how One Ops finance adds value through forecasting, period end close analysis, management reporting, and other processes. Be ready to ideate, build, and implement new ways of working, analyses, reporting, and more. We need someone who can think creatively, but also execute with both discipline and a continuous-improvement mindset.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to help shape the future-state of One Ops Finance by building structure in a complex environment, solving ambiguous problems, and transforming manual processes into scalable, automated, and well-controlled solutions.

Primary Responsibilities:

With a focus on transformation, drive end-to-end planning and forecasting for manufacturing networks, translating operational assumptions into robust P&L and cost forecasts Collaborate with cross-functional partners to problem solve and develop solutions and processes that bring greater efficiencies and effectiveness to the One Ops Finance teamLead the development of digital FP&A solutions that provide actionable insights into P&L performance, enabling proactive identification of cost drivers, margin impacts, and risks / opportunitiesConduct data analysis and synthesize findings to communicate insights to stakeholders and leadership

Qualifications

BA/BS with major in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology or related fieldMinimum 4 years of experience in Finance, AccountingAdvanced computer based analytical skills and knowledge of analytic software packages (Excel, Power BI, etc…)Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect data to business implicationsAbility to manage complexity, ambiguity, and competing prioritiesSelf-starter; independent thinker who can connect dots quickly Proven ability to influence without authority and work effectively across a matrix organization. Strong communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in FP&A, operations / supply chain finance Knowledge of costing, accounting and proven understanding of financial statements (P&L and Balance Sheet), preferably Nestlé specific Strong foundational knowledge of frontier-pushing digital toolsSAP, Oracle, other ERP experience

Salary: $99,214.07 to $136,430.25 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

rows.descriptionText:
Title: Senior Analyst, Customer Supply Chain – Consumer Products Division

Location: Clark, NJ

Reports To: Director of Customer Supply Chain

Hello, we're L'Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.

A Day in the Life

Reporting to the Director of Customer Supply Chain, you lead end-to-end operational collaboration with Amazon, steering planning, forecasting, and replenishment to keep our products flowing smoothly.

Retailer Partnership & Execution: Steer daily supply chain operations with Amazon to raise on-time and in-full (OTIF) delivery metrics, cut order lead times, and reduce shortage deductions.Network & Flow Optimisation: Model distribution routes across our network of 158 Fulfillment Centres to pinpoint cost efficiencies, resolve shipment gaps, and support peak tentpole events.Data Analytics & Systems: Analyse service KPIs and operational trends using Power BI to recommend performance solutions, partnering with IT to resolve EDI data flows swiftly.Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner directly with Sales, Physical Distribution, and Transportation teams to balance commercial demand surges with sustainable fulfillment practices.

Required Qualifications

We Are Looking For:

Bachelor’s Degree required in Supply Chain or related business fieldYou bring a rigorous analytical mindset and the drive to solve complex supply chain challenges in real time. You bring:Supply Chain Expertise: Practical knowledge of demand planning, inventory flow, order management, and retailer replenishment routines.Advanced Analytics: Strong capability in Power BI, advanced Excel, and relational data management to interpret KPIs and translate data anomalies into concrete action plans.Operational Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot EDI mapping discrepancies and investigate root causes behind order or shipment misses.Stakeholder Management: Clear communication skills to align cross-functional teams and collaborate directly with key retail partners.Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to identifying efficiencies across warehousing, logistics channels, and operational workflows.Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent, ongoing basis is required. No immigration support/sponsorship offered for this role.Being present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office-based roles for eligible full-time employees.

What's In It For You

A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)Salary: $77,400- $110,300 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level)Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan)Hybrid Work Policy (3 Days in Office, 2 Days Work from Home) Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!)Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance)Learning & Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!)Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)

Who We Are

At L'Oréal Operations, we harness industry-leading technology and sustainable practices across 7 distinct métiers to deliver over 6 billion products annually. With 131 carbon-neutral sites and ongoing Industry 4.0 transformations across our 36 plants and 158 fulfillment centres, we create responsible beauty at global scale.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, you may request an accommodation at any time.

rows.title: Sr Mgr, Network Siting & SC Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Sr Mgr, Network Siting & SC Strategy

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

E2E Supply Chain Leader, Allergy

Location:

North America, United States, New Jersey, Summit

Work Location:

Hybrid

What You Will Do

The Senior Manager will lead end-to-end network strategy and siting for the North American Self Care Supply Chain. This role represents the regional network perspective across new-product siting, re-siting, innovation, renovation, sourcing, and portfolio initiatives, influences cross-functional decisions, and ensures initiatives align with business objectives and the long-term network roadmap.

The position evaluates manufacturing, delivery, and trade-customization networks for feasibility and risk, supports inventory and customer-service objectives, builds a pipeline of savings and gross-profit opportunities, and program manages complex supply chain initiatives from business case through governance approval. rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. rows.title: Insight Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana (formerly IRI and NPD) is the leading advisor on the complexity of consumer behaviour. Through unparalleled technology, advanced analytics, cross-industry data, and deep expertise, we provide clarity that helps almost 7,000 of the world’s leading brands and retailers take action and unlock business growth. We understand more about the complete consumer, the complete store, and the complete wallet so our clients can go beyond the data to apply insights, ignite innovation, meet consumer demand, and outpace the competition.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities (with us you can always bring your full self to work). Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Learn more at www.circana.com.

What will you be doing? 

You will be a member of the Category Growth team, working on a portfolio of clients. The Insight Manager is a critical member of the team, leading our partnership on a day to day basis and as a result the ideal candidate would need to have a degree of autonomy and problem-solving capabilities. This role requires an insight led approach using the Circana solutions to create advantage and growth opportunities for our client. The candidate should have a track record of using innovative and inspiring insight to grow our client’s business, paired with superb organizational and interpersonal engagement skills to deliver an all-round excellent service to the client. The role is not a delivery management, or passive account stewardship role. The focus is revenue ownership, strategic growth, and long-term account expansion.

Job Responsibilities

Coordinates, executes, analyses, and presents findings from a variety of insight projects commissioned by the client, positioning in an influential manner with recommendations, actions and quantified new opportunities. To act as a business consultant driving engagement and penetration of Circana, and our solutions, across all client functions through the execution of effective engagement strategies. Develop and leverage strong, collaborative relationships with external and internal stakeholders and work closely with other Circana functions to deliver an all-round positive client experience. First point of contact for clients on day-to-day issues and champion the clients need within the wider Circana organisation. Responsible for updating all business performance metrics and accurate financial reporting. Development and deployment of our technology capabilities, bringing the best Circana has to offer to our client’s fingertips to drive efficiencies and enhance business reportingMonthly travel to client offices and less frequent on-site days at the Circana main office (Bracknell). 

Requirements

Experience in the application of market measurement data including shopper. Ability to articulate complex technical knowledge of solutions in a simple impactful manner. Effective team player and proven ability to work remotely as well as onsite with clients across virtual and diverse teams. Leverages mutually beneficial relationships and networks strongly both internally and externally. Strong project and workload management and proactive management of stakeholder expectations. Ability to proactively manage a client relationship and drive improvements in client satisfaction. Able to engage in a consultative manner with clients at all levels when helping solve/manage content deliverables and critical business challenges. Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills as demonstrated by the ability to use appropriate method to communicate with clients, professional presence, ability to understand and respond to another’s point of view. Previous experience in cross selling Circana solutions. Strong commercial acumen: appreciation of contractual obligations, financial reporting, corporate policies and input into business planning. 

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviours sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questionsSeek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire actionOwn the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choicesCenter on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customersBe a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvementChampion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect and integrityCommit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone

Location 

This role will have the requirement to travel to the client’s offices; Rainham, Chalfont, Uxbridge, and Circana’s Head Office in Bracknell (roughly once per month).

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Make Your Mark at Ipsos

Are you a creative marketer who loves turning ideas and insights into engaging content? Do you enjoy social media, digital marketing and bringing campaigns to life? If you’re looking for a varied role with international exposure where you can make a visible impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Join the central Ipsos Synthesio global team in this creative and varied marketing role, helping to build awareness of Ipsos Synthesio and generate new business opportunities. Ipsos Synthesio is a social listening platform that captures and analyses what people say and search for online across channels including social media, forums, video, blogs, news and reviews.

You’ll help bring our story to life across LinkedIn, our website, YouTube and other channels, owning and delivering the content calendar and creating everything from insight blogs and visual social content to videos and scripts. You’ll also support webinars, client sessions and industry events, coordinate customer case studies and the Ipsos Synthesio newsletter, and contribute to paid social campaigns and audience targeting.

Essential skills:

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent organisation and attention to detail.Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities while communicating clearly with colleagues.Creative, proactive and quality-focused, with an eye for engaging marketing content.Experience creating marketing campaigns and supporting audience targeting.Digitally savvy, with experience using B2B social media such as LinkedIn, publishing online content and working with virtual webinar technology.Proficiency in AI use and adoption to enhance day-to-day tasks, including the ability to critically assess and refine AI-generated content.

Desirable Skills

B2B marketing experience, ideally within SaaS or a digital marketing environment.Understanding of the consumer insights, marketing and digital marketing landscape.Familiarity with social listening platforms and Boolean queries.Experience using design tools such as Canva.Understanding of website and marketing performance tools such as Google Analytics.

Behaviours

You’ll bring the Ipsos behaviours to life by:

Integrity: taking pride in delivering high-quality work and following through on commitments.Curiosity: looking for new, innovative and agile ways to approach marketing challenges.Collaboration: working effectively with colleagues across UK and global teams.Client First: keeping client and commercial needs front of mind.Entrepreneurial Spirit: bringing creative thinking, commercial awareness and flexibility to your work.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities.

We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application.

We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process.

Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

Ready to have an impact? Apply now!

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

rows.title: Manager, FSQA
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

The Manager, FSQA is responsible for leading Food Safety, Quality Assurance, Supplier Quality, and Regulatory Compliance programs to ensure the consistent delivery of safe, high-quality products across the supply chain. This role partners closely with operations, procurement, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, strengthen food safety culture, and ensure compliance with company standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

What You'll Do

Lead and maintain Food Safety and Quality Management Systems to ensure compliance with company, customer, regulatory, and GFSI requirements. Oversee product quality and compliance for assigned product categories across the U.S. and Canadian supply chain, ensuring ingredients meet Domino’s standards, customer expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements. Own and maintain product specifications and supplier documentation for assigned categories, including product attributes, organoleptic characteristics, physical measures, analytical measures, and regulatory requirements. Lead product reviews and ongoing product performance evaluations, including organoleptic and analytical assessments, trend analysis, reporting, and follow-up actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Manage product quality incidents and complaint management processes for assigned categories, including intake, investigation, root cause analysis, supplier corrective actions, escalation, communication, and timely closure. Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert for Cheese/Dairy quality and food safety, providing technical guidance to suppliers, Procurement, R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, and FSQA teams. Oversee supplier quality programs, including supplier approval, risk assessments, audits, corrective actions, and performance monitoring. Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to food safety, quality performance, sanitation, environmental monitoring, and risk reduction. Partners with Operations, Procurement, R&D, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product quality and food safety requirements are integrated into business processes. Provide technical guidance and coaching to cross-functional teams and suppliers to strengthen food safety culture, product quality, and compliance. Identify opportunities to leverage technology and analytics to improve the overall quality and safety of Domino’s food. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in food science or related field; Master’s preferred7+ years of quality assurance or related experience, in food manufacturing, or research and developmentStrong interpersonal and relationship building skills across functions and all organizational levelsAble to identify opportunities, set goals, and work independentlyExtensive knowledge of cheese/dairy products preferred. Excellent oral and written communication skillsAbility to communicate with suppliers, internal leadership, and team membersStrong statistical analysis skillsHACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point) certification and strong knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices, Good Laboratory Practices, Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures, preferredAble to manage multiple projects and manage time effectively with minimal guidance. Excellent knowledge of computer skills including MS Office suite of programsAvailability to be on call to support product incident responses outside of normal business hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Travel up to 30% of the time

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

As the Vice President of Campaign Diversity, you will own the product strategy and execution for Epsilon’s campaign diversity pod, expanding Epsilon’s platform to support a broader range of full-funnel campaigns executed on behalf of Groupe and Direct customers. Reporting to the SVP of Product, this role will lead the evolution of Epsilon’s campaign capabilities from awareness through conversion, including support for new channels, private deals, stronger alignment with third-party measurement, and more advanced optimization capabilities. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of Epsilon’s campaign capabilities. Success will require translating the needs of agencies, operators, and commercial stakeholders into a clear product strategy that expands the types of campaigns Epsilon can support, strengthens performance in independent measurement environments, and increases Epsilon’s ability to work across new channels, inventory types, and deal structures. You will define vision, align stakeholders, and lead the development of products that broaden campaign flexibility, strengthen measurement credibility, and drive meaningful business impact.

This is a highly strategic role that requires a resourceful leader with strong judgment, organizational savvy, interpersonal skills, self-motivation, and excellent communication. rows.title: Senior Reporting Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We need a Market Research Data Processing Specialist to clean, organize, and analyse survey data. We will use Crunch to turn raw survey responses into clean data assets for our research team.

Key Responsibilities

Data Cleaning/ Quality: Check survey data for errors, missing values, and wrong answers.Data Processing: Perform cleaning, data merging, and formatting using available tools/ techniques i.e. R/ Crunch Automation scrips. Etc as per tab speck and questionnaire.Crunch Platform Management: Upload, organize, and maintain datasets within Crunch for team access.Coding Open-Ends: Group and label text answers from open-ended survey questions.Dashboard Support: Help build interactive visual tools and reports for clients within crunch.


Requirements

Experience: 4+ years of working experience in market research domain under data processing team.Software Skills: R programing or SPSS or IBM SPSS Dimensions - DMS Validation, Advanced Excel (e.g. Advanced Formulas; Pivot Tables; Macros) is recommended).Attention to Detail: Strong focus on finding and fixing errors in large data sets.Education: A bachelor's degree in Statistics, Math, Data Science, or a related field.


Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Have - Not Mandatory)

Software Skills: Power BI/ SQL/ HTML/ Understanding JSON survey schemaData Wrangling: Ability to manipulate data using R libraries (like tidyverse or dplyr).

rows.title: Customer Onboarding Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

The salary range for this role is $60,000 - $75,000/year + Bonus

The Customer Onboarding Manager is a critical position within the Customer Team. This individual owns the first phase of the customer journey, ensuring customer expectations are met and key success milestones are achieved. The Customer Onboarding Manager partners closely with customers and internal stakeholders to drive adoption, build user confidence, and accelerate time-to-value through effective onboarding, training, and enablement.

This role leverages data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency, personalize customer experiences, and scale best practices while maintaining a high-touch, customer-centric approach.

What You'll Do

Lead customer onboarding engagements, ensuring timely implementation and achievement of onboarding milestones. Partner with Account Team members to build and execute onboarding plans aligned to customer goals and business outcomes. Conduct customer training sessions and enablement activities that help users confidently adopt and maximize the value of Numerator solutions. Develop and maintain onboarding materials, learning resources, project documentation, and customer communications. Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience while maintaining high standards of quality and judgment. Confirm and refine customer use cases to help customers expand platform adoption and realize measurable business impact. Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as a strategic partner during the onboarding journey. Analyze onboarding progress, customer feedback, and adoption metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement. Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, including AI capabilities, and recommend practical applications that improve team effectiveness and customer outcomes. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Bachelor's or Master's degree with at least 3 years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, customer success, project management, training, or a related field. Experience in research and survey design is strongly preferred. Familiarity with consumer panel data and/or the CPG/retail industry is a plus. Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to educate and influence diverse audiences. Proven ability to build trusted relationships and guide customers through change and adoption. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple onboarding engagements simultaneously. Analytical mindset with the ability to identify customer needs, interpret data, derive insights, and develop action plans. Experience using AI-enabled productivity, analytics, or workflow tools in a professional environment, or demonstrated ability to learn and adopt emerging technologies quickly. Ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve efficiency, generate ideas, create documentation, and enhance customer experiences while applying sound business judgment. Working knowledge of enterprise software applications and services designed for the retail and consumer goods industries is highly valued (e.g., Nielsen, IRI, NPD, Dunnhumby). Expertise with one or more of Numerator's products is advantageous. Client travel may be required, typically one to two trips per quarter, though frequency may vary based on business needs.

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

Hearst is seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Director, Events Marketing to lead the planning, execution and evolution of the company’s corporate events portfolio. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Hearst brings its brand, culture, leadership and business priorities to life through exceptional experiences that engage colleagues, clients, partners and industry leaders.

The Senior Director will oversee the strategy, development and execution of high-profile events that strengthen Hearst's reputation, support business objectives and foster meaningful connections across the organization and beyond. From executive conferences and leadership forums to employee engagement initiatives, philanthropic programs and client-facing events, this role serves as a key steward of the Hearst brand experience.

The ideal candidate is a creative and highly organized events leader with exceptional project management skills, strong executive presence, sound business judgment and a passion for creating memorable experiences.

Strategy & Event Experience

Develop and execute a comprehensive events strategy that supports Hearst's corporate priorities, business objectives and brand reputation. Lead the creation of engaging event concepts and experiences that reflect Hearst's culture, values and leadership position. Identify innovative event formats, technologies and industry trends to ensure Hearst remains forward-thinking and relevant. Partner with senior leadership and internal stakeholders to develop event experiences that drive engagement and deliver measurable impact. Lead the exploration and adoption of AI and emerging technologies to drive innovation in event design, audience engagement, content development, and event analytics. 

Event Planning & Execution

Lead the planning and execution of Hearst's corporate events portfolio, including executive conferences, client events, employee engagement initiatives, leadership programs, philanthropic events and special projects. Oversee event logistics, production, presentations, venues, catering, décor, technology, registration and communications. Manage Hearst Tower event reservations and coordinate with Facilities, Dining Services, IT and other internal teams. Ensure flawless execution and a consistently high standard of quality across all events. 

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Lead and develop internal team members while overseeing external agencies, vendors, and production partners to ensure successful delivery of Hearst’s events portfolio and a consistently high standard of execution. Build and maintain strong relationships with executives, business leaders, clients, partners and internal stakeholders. Serve as the primary liaison between Hearst and external vendors, agencies, venues and production partners. Negotiate contracts and manage vendor relationships to maximize value and service. 

Budget Management & Operations

Develop, manage and track event budgets. Establish timelines, processes and project management systems that support successful execution across multiple initiatives. Lead post-event evaluations and continuous improvement efforts. 

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in corporate event management, experiential marketing, hospitality or related fields. Experience leading large-scale, high-profile events and executive-level programs. Strong strategic planning, project management and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior executives and stakeholders. 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $150,000 - $185,000. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York City, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

About Us

Hearst is a leading global, diversified information, services, and media company dedicated to innovating, informing audiences and leading with purpose, integrity and a culture of care.

Our portfolio includes more than 360 businesses worldwide. On the consumer side, we operate 35 television stations, 28 daily newspapers and publish more than 200 magazine editions featuring many of the most iconic brands in media. We also hold ownership stakes in leading cable networks such as A&E, HISTORY, Lifetime and ESPN. On the business-to-business side, our companies include Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information and analytics; Hearst Health, which provides intelligence and software that improve care outcomes; and Hearst Transportation, which delivers data and software for aviation, automotive and trucking.

Our strength lies in our people. We value the diverse perspectives that move us forward. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, military or veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. We also provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees consistent with applicable law.

About The Team

Our Corporate Teams deliver essential programs and services that support the entire Hearst enterprise. Spanning communications, employee benefits, finance, learning and development, legal, technology, and more, these teams lead initiatives that advance Hearst’s mission to inform and inspire. Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow, collaborate and make a lasting impact.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

Our Audit team is critical to our business. They work closely with Risk and Compliance to create internal risk management and compliance processes, and make sure they’re running efficiently.

We’re looking for an Internal Auditor to execute end-to-end, risk-based customer journey and compliance audits. You’ll assess our retail and business offerings from a customer experience perspective, while analysing financial products against relevant regulations and obligations.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

Experience in an audit-related role within a regulated financial services environmentExperience in one or more of the following areas: customer support channels, customer satisfaction, complaints, regulatory compliance frameworks, or customer communicationsKnowledge of relevant European and UK regulations and frameworksProficiency in working with and interpreting data, ideally with experience in SQL, SAS, Python, or RKnowledge of IIA standardsSolid critical thinking and problem-solving skillsGreat interpersonal and communication skillsThe desire and drive to learn, grow, and make an impact quickly as part of an expanding team

An ACA, CFA, or FRM certificationExperience working in a fast-paced environment with a focus on execution

We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. About the role:We’re looking for a commercially minded, technically strong individual contributor to join our Business Intelligence team at Cuvva. You’ll report to BI Management, working on some of the most interesting data and analytical problems across our insurance business.
We’re deliberately keeping this role broad. You might currently be working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or BI Manager, but what matters most is the depth of your analytical thinking, your understanding of insurance, and your ability to turn data into better commercial decisions.
You’ll work with complex datasets to understand performance, identify trends and opportunities, and help us make smarter decisions about our products and our business. You’ll bring industry knowledge, strong statistical reasoning, hands-on experience with SQL and Python, and the curiosity to dig beyond the obvious answer. You’ll be comfortable moving between detailed analysis and the bigger commercial question: what does this tell us, and what should we do about it?
Insurance experience is important to us, particularly within personal lines. Motor insurance is especially relevant, but we'd also consider strong candidates from other personal lines backgrounds such as home or pet. You’ll bring an understanding of how insurance businesses operate, the role data plays in pricing and performance, and the commercial factors that sit behind the numbers.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across areas including performance monitoring, pricing, product analytics, marketing, data science and AI, partnering with teams across Cuvva to turn analysis into action. We’re looking for someone who can challenge thinking, spot opportunities, explain complex ideas clearly and help us make better decisions through data.
On a day-to-day basis you’ll:
Manipulate, analyse and interpret datasets to provide insights and recommendations that help our business make better decisions  Work directly with our Head of Product to size opportunities before we build them, and to measure the impact of what we've shipped once it's liveDesign and interpret A/B tests and feature rollouts, with a clear view on what the result means for the product and wider businessWork day to day with behavioural data, using funnel analysis and event tracking to connect app behaviour with policy, pricing and claims dataAnalyse pricing, business and product performance, identifying trends, opportunities and areas where deeper investigation is neededFollow analysis through to claims and loss ratio, so we understand the risk and commercial impact of what we ship, not just conversion Own metric definitions and contribute to our semantic layer, helping ensure the business works from a consistent version of each numberCollaborate with BI and Data Engineering colleagues on analytical and data projectsDrive self-serve analytics across the business by coaching stakeholders and building the dashboards, metrics and documentation they need to answer their own questionsSupport the Product team as we launch and iterate on new products and features
You’ll do great here if you have: 
Experience working with data in the insurance industry, ideally within personal lines and preferably motorStrong statistical reasoning, and can explain what an analysis does and doesn't support, including the assumptions and limitations behind your conclusionsA strong commercial mindset and can connect analysis to business performance, customer outcomes and commercial decisionsAre highly proficient in SQL and Python, being comfortable using Python for analysis, modelling and problem solvingCan work confidently with complex datasets, joining information from different sources to uncover insights and answer ambiguous questionsStrong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner with senior stakeholders, ask the right questions and challenge thinking when neededExcellent communication skills and can turn complex analysis into a clear story, recommendation or decision for your audienceAre comfortable working across functions and collaborating with BI, Data Engineering, Product, Pricing and other teams to solve problemsExperience working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or in a similar analytical roleAre curious about new approaches to data, including data science and AI, and are interested in how they can improve the way we make decisionsThe ability to take an ambiguous business problem, work out what we need to know, and independently take it from question through analysis and recommendation
It’s a bonus if you have: 
Have designed, run or interpreted experiments, A/B tests or feature rolloutsHave worked with a behavioural analytics tool such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4 alongside a data warehouseHave experience with machine learning models, including understanding how their performance and accuracy are evaluated
The hiring process: (All interviews are held remotely)
Initial chat with hiring manager (60m)Technical interview & live challenge with peers (90m)Values interview with People team & stakeholders (45m)Founders chat with our CEO, Freddy (20m)
Benefits:As well as a competitive salary (80,000 - £100,000 depending on experience), benefits of working at Cuvva include:Very flexible WFH set up, we only ask folks to come in a couple of times a month for team strategy days and socials - but of course, you're more than welcome to come in as much as you like! A four day work week (Fridays off!) An office worth visiting - Old Sessions House is a stunning private members club with a rooftop, infinity pool and regular members events. Not your average workplace!Transparent salary model and bands for all roles (without sharing anyone's individual salary of course!) 20.5 days of holiday a year + public holidays - rising with each year at Cuvva 🌞 (holidays have been prorated based on our 4DWW)Quarterly team socials and company events Private medical insurance with BupaProfessional development budgetHealth, WFH and wellbeing budget 🧘 ♂️Increases to all allowances year on yearEnhanced parental leave and payCycle to work schemeMental Health and Coaching Support - We offer free and confidential access to comprehensive mental healthcare and coaching through Oliva. Giving you the space to talk to a coach or therapist about anything you likeHundreds of perks and discounts with Perkbox£100 a month towards your Cuvva car insuranceReferral bonus when you bring your friends to join the Cuvva team 💸
Referrals:Know someone who could be right for this job? We’d love to hear from them, please drop us a note at jobs@cuvva.com to let us know who you'll be referring and for which role. If they get the job, you will receive an Apple Watch! If someone has already applied to the role before we receive your email they will not be considered a referral, so please check with them beforehand to make sure 🙂
Cuvva ways of working: We’re dedicated to creating a place where people want to work, a place where people believe in what they’re doing, have clear expectations and a bunch of freedom. 
Our approach to hybrid working is very flexible: we only ask people to come a couple of times a month for team building or company events. The rest of time it’s up to you where and how you work. You can of course come into the office as much as you like! 
Diversity, inclusion and belonging at Cuvva:At Cuvva, we’re dedicated to building an environment where individuals from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging and have the support they need to thrive. To us, it’s crucial that our differences are embraced and celebrated - and that you’re able to bring your whole self to work everyday. 
Research shows that men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, but women and those in traditionally underrepresented groups tend to apply only if they check all the boxes. If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an Industry Product Owner

If you have a passion to design and run our Industry Journey & Operations for NatWest vulnerable arrears customers, this role could be for youYou’ll continually identify opportunities to digitise, improve and manage the customer journey to deliver increased value and an effortless customer experienceThis is your opportunity to drive all business performance and proposition activities, making sure our customer journey runs with true customer and commercial focus

What you'll do

Through your role as an Industry Product Owner, you’ll drive and deliver a prioritised journey backlog to improve the end-to-end customer journey, identifying opportunities and providing your expertise. On top of this, you’ll be delivering, consolidating and automating all business performance and proposition activities that keep the customer journey running seamlessly.

Day-to-day, You’ll Be

Monitoring competitor, industry and regulatory developments across the journey portfolio and actively identifying responses to market, policy and customer needsManaging incidents effectively, and looking for opportunities to increase resilience within the customer journeyStriving to deliver a world-class customer experience and placing the customer at the heart of all we doMaking empowered decisions to deliver the prioritised journey backlog

The skills you'll need

You’ll be a subject matter expert in product proposition and process design. Additionally, you’ll have excellent knowledge of critical Agile capabilities and ways of working, as well as the ability to exercise change delivery, customer experience design, commercial management and analytics.

We’ll Also Expect

Good experience of building and maintaining relationships with external stakeholders across the debt advice sector, charities, industry bodies and policy forums to identify emerging needs, influence positive customer outcomes and inform backlog prioritiesExperience representing an organisation in industry forums and partnerships, working with charities, debt advice organisations and policy stakeholders to shape future customer support journeys and deliver better outcomes for customers in financial difficultyExperience of driving and delivering innovative ideas through Agile ways of working, looking at harnessing digital and technological advances that truly benefit our customersA proven ability to adapt to quickly changing environmentsA talented communicator who can inspire and engage both customers and colleagues

rows.title: Data Scientist, Economic Crime Hub
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Data Scientist, Economic Crime Hub

You’ll design and implement data science tools and methods which harness our data that use our data to prevent fraud and scams, reduce customer harm and financial losses, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of fraud decisioningWe’ll look to you to actively participate in the Fraud, Engineering and Data community to identify and deliver opportunities to support the bank’s strategic direction through better use of dataThis is an opportunity to promote data literacy education with business stakeholders supporting them to foster a data driven culture and to make a real impact with your work

What You'll Do

As a Data Scientist, you’ll combine statistical analysis, machine learning, generative AI and software engineering to develop practical, responsible solutions to fraud and scam challenges. You’ll work with fraud stakeholders and customer teams to understand their needs, form clear hypotheses and identify data-led solutions that improve fraud detection, reduce false positives, support timely intervention and deliver measurable fraud prevention and operational.

You’ll Also Be

Working with fraud stakeholders to translate fraud and scam challenges into clear analytical questions and measurable outcomesApplying a software engineering and product development practices to build reusable pipelines, test changes, and deploy scalable solutions in an Agile environmentSelecting, building, training and testing machine learning models, fraud strategies and AI applications, balancing fraud detection and business value with customer impact, operational capacity, model risk and ethical considerationsMonitoring internal and third-party fraud models for performance, data quality, drift and business effectiveness, recommending corrective action where neededInvestigating emerging fraud patterns, unusual alerts and missed fraud events, turning findings into practical improvements and maintaining clear evidence for governance, audit and regulatory review

The Skills You'll Need

You’ll need a strong academic background in a STEM discipline such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or Computer Science. You’ll have experience with statistical modelling and machine learning techniques applied to fraud or other complex risk problems involving rare events.

You’ll Also Demonstrate

The ability to use data to solve business problems from hypotheses through to resolutionExperience using programming language and software engineering fundamentalsExperience of Cloud applications and optionsExperience in synthesising, translating and visualising data and insights for key stakeholdersExperience in model monitoring, model-risk governance and documenting analytical decisions for review and challenge is desirable.Knowledge of how Large Language Models and agentic AI can support fraud and scam analysis, and the controls required to manage the risks of using those applications, is also desirable

rows.title: Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Product Owner, Economic Crime Hub

This is an exciting opportunity to join an expanding Product Team within the newly formed Economic Crime Hub, where Fraud, Financial Crime and Data & Analytics have come together to create a market-leading capability. You'll play a pivotal role in developing innovative, data-driven solutions that stay one step ahead of increasingly sophisticated AI-enabled fraud and scam activity, helping to protect millions of customers and the wider economyTake ownership of products that make a real difference. You'll define and deliver a compelling product vision and roadmap that supports the Economic Crime Hub's mission to combat evolving fraud and financial crime threats through data, analytics and cutting-edge technologyWork alongside experts across Fraud, Financial Crime, Data & Analytics and Technology, building strong relationships and harnessing customer and stakeholder insights to develop products that create meaningful business and customer outcomesJoin a culture that values curiosity, innovation and continuous learning. Leveraging Agile ways of working, you'll inspire teams to innovate, embrace change and deliver products that help us stay one step ahead of criminal activity in an increasingly AI-driven landscape

What you'll do

As a Product Owner, you’ll work closely with Data Analytics, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and build our new Fraud Profiling and Decisioning platform. You’ll play a key role in defining and delivering critical capabilities, navigating complex data environments and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions.

As well as this, you’ll bring the point of view of our customers, end users or stakeholders to the forefront of understanding the product vision. With exceptional leadership skills, you’ll drive your team towards this vision, regularly stopping along the way to checkin, adjust, calibrate and move forward. We’ll also look to you to make sure that stories and enablers meet acceptance and quality criteria, keeping them inline with the vision and strategic objectives.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Ensuring your delivery teams are aligned to and delivering against the product vision, working closely with customers and users to validate priorities, incorporate feedback and maximise value at every stage of deliveryParticipating in iteration ceremonies to enable continuous improvementWorking with enterprise architects and teams to understand and prioritise the enablersSupporting the development of your teams by answering any questions and removing impedimentsTracking progress, and attending any retrospective spanning all delivery teams that are involved with delivering the product

The skills you'll need

You’ll be a decisive, commercially minded product leader with strong Agile expertise and a clear focus on customer and business outcomes.

You’ll Also Need

The ability to lead complex financial platforms from early build through to production and scale, confidently shaping direction and technical trade-offs with architecture and engineering teamsFraud or Financial Crime experience is strongly preferredThe ability to connect customer journeys across Retail, Wealth and Commercial, identify gaps in fraud profiling and decisioning, and own a credible migration plan and its outcomesStrong senior stakeholder and multi-vendor management skills, translating real business problems into clear product direction and a compelling platform story that builds belief and momentumA commercial mindset, with experience building and defending business cases, tracking ROI and benefits realisation, and applying strong product fundamentals across prioritisation, backlog management and delivery governance

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are looking for a strategic, highly organized marketing leader to help build and execute Uber's global go-to-market strategy across priority growth areas. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, integrated marketing, and cross-functional execution, helping define the frameworks, operating model, and campaign approach that bring clarity and consistency to how we launch and scale work globally.

This person will bring deep integrated marketing experience, strong strategic thinking, and a proven ability to turn business priorities into clear marketing frameworks, compelling campaigns, and measurable outcomes. They will partner closely with teams across regional marketing, creative, media, research, operations, product, comms, and finance to ensure go-to-market plans are aligned, high-quality, and built to scale.

What You'll Do

 Lead the development of global go-to-market frameworks that translate business goals into clear marketing strategy, messaging, channel approach, and execution.  Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize workstreams, align on objectives, and bring structure to complex, multi-market initiatives.  Develop integrated marketing briefs and strategic recommendations that guide creative, media, and channel execution across global campaigns.  Manage end-to-end campaign planning and execution for priority launches and select global IMCs, ensuring strategic rigour, strong creative, scaled efforts and on-time delivery.  Agency Management: Work closely with creative and media agencies, as well as internal partners, to develop breakthrough, consumer-relevant, and operationally feasible marketing plans.  Support media and investment planning by helping shape how budgets are allocated, where to test, and how to scale what works.  Define measurement plans in partnership with analytics, research, and media teams; evaluate campaign performance, surface insights, and recommend optimizations.  Scale Global Efforts: Build repeatable ways of working that improve speed, clarity, and quality across global and regional stakeholders.  Executive Communication: Create strong written materials and executive-ready recommendations for senior leadership. 

Basic Qualifications

 5+ years of experience in integrated marketing, brand marketing, or go-to-market strategy, ideally at a fast-paced, consumer-facing brand.  Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or similar, and a demonstrated ability in quantitative fields 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience creating scalable marketing operating models, planning frameworks, or playbooks across multiple markets.  Proven track record of delivering successful and breakthrough work, with a high bar for quality, productivity, and delivering results  Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build frameworks, connect the dots across workstreams, and turn ambiguity into clear action.  Experience managing agency partners and collaborating effectively with internal creative, media, analytics, comms, and operations teams.  Consumer obsessed, with a drive to continuously learn more about our core consumers, identify how our products meet their needs, and understand how to most effectively share our brand message with them.  Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform strategy, prioritize investments, and improve performance.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.  Excellent organizational skills to juggle many tasks without losing sight of the highest priority items and a desire to create and build new processes to enable organizational efficiencies.  A hard-working, thorough, organized, and motivated self-starter, constantly striving to improve their skills and look for ways to contribute to the team. Thrives on challenges and can stay calm in complicated/complex situations.

As an Application Developer for Work Management, you are at the heart of our productivity, designing and building the Atlassian-based systems that keep thousands of Uber employees aligned and moving fast.

This isn't just about managing Jira tickets-it's about engineering intelligent, integrated ecosystems. The pace here is intense, the systems are massive, and the stakes are high. 5+ years of combined experience in software engineering and/or Atlassian platform administration and development (Jira/Confluence Cloud or Data Center). Experience using ScriptRunner for complex automation and workflow enhancement. Experience working with Atlassian REST and GraphQL APIs for third-party integrations. Experience managing and configuring Atlassian marketplace apps (e.g., Structure, JEMH, EazyBI). Demonstrated use of AI-powered developer tools in daily engineering workflows (e.g., AI-assisted coding or debugging).

Experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Atlassian Rovo Agents and LLM integrations. Expertise in prompt engineering and defining agent actions within enterprise workflows. Proven ability to design enterprise-scale dashboards and analytics using EazyBI. Experience supporting large, complex organizations with rigorous governance requirements. Strong systems thinking and the ability to thrive in high-ambiguity environments.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer II - AV Labs
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race-and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.

As a ML Engineer, you will be at the forefront of Physical AI , building advanced autonomy algorithms and models to add rich semantics to our massive driving data . You will be responsible for the development and implementation of the latest machine learning techniques that enables better data mining, deep scene understanding, and causal modeling of ego vehicle behavior .The ideal candidate will be able to identify complex edge cases, provide robust algorithmic solutions, and set a high technical excellence bar.

What You Will Do

 Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms and foundation models that extract high-fidelity semantic meaning from complex urban edge cases to enrich our L4 data lake .  System Design: Implement scalable ML systems, including management of upstream sensor dependencies.  Dataset Optimization: Deliver high-quality datasets to accelerate ML technologies through advanced sensor data collection, processing, and auto-labeling.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with platform, product, and security engineering teams to enable the successful deployment of the latest machine learning techniques into production. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 2+ years of working experience in the ML/Robotics industry.  Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Proficient in Python and Linux environments.  Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience in the Autonomous Driving domain.  Proven track record of deploying ML models in safety-critical physical systems.  Master's or PhD degree in Computer Vision, Robotics, or Machine Learning.  Familiarity with C++ and high-performance computing.
