rows.title: U.S Immigration Manager
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives.  Lead, coach, and develop the U.S. Immigration Specialist (L4), providing strategic direction, prioritization, performance management, and career development. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of U.S. business immigration experience, demonstrating deep expertise in employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.  5+ program management experience, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution.  5+ years operating in complex, matrixed organizations, partnering with Senior level stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with a track record of developing scalable programs and delivering measurable business impact.  Experience managing external immigration vendors, including governance, performance management, commercial oversight, vendor selection, and contract management.  Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve program effectiveness and stakeholder experience.  Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions at all levels of the organization.  Passion for delivering exceptional employee and stakeholder experiences.

You'll partner with leaders across Product, Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and more - aligning strategy, execution, and measurement so we can scale our growing Offers platform. This is a high-visibility role where your work will help shape how offers are created, managed, and redeemed by restaurants and users around the world.

This role will sit within our Offers Marketing Optimization team, helping to launch and scale new offers products in a fast-paced, rapidly growing business within Uber.

What You Will Do

 Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders to launch and scale Offers platform and tooling products.  Help define go-to-market plans and operational processes to support the Offers product strategy.  Develop end-to-end product rollout plans and project-manage implementation across teams and markets. Deep understanding of user experience and the ability to translate user, business, and operational needs into product insights.  Ability to leverage data to inform and support critical decisions. rows.title: Sr Staff ML Engineer - Applied AI
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

The Applied AI team collaborates with product teams across Uber to deliver innovative AI solutions for core business problems. We work closely with engineering, product and data science teams to understand core business problems and the potential for AI solutions, then deliver those AI solutions end-to-end. Key areas of expertise include Personalization, Generative AI, Computer Vision, ML Optimization, Geospatial AI.

About The Role

We are building AI-native discovery experiences across Mobility and Delivery. Search, recommendations, and conversational AI are central to how millions of users discover rides, restaurants, grocery items, and retail products every day. We are hiring a Senior Staff ML Engineer to define the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models powering these experiences.

The Uber Foundation Model would serve as the common semantic backbone that enables Uber to understand users, places, merchants, items, and behavioral patterns in a unified way. By building a shared representation layer and continuously improving it with cross-LOB signals, Uber ensures that intelligence compounds rather than fragments. This foundation powers personalization, search, agents, automation, and decision systems across Mobility, Delivery, and future surfaces.

At this level, you will set the long-term technical direction for the organization, drive alignment on product and engineering strategy at the executive level, and deliver step-change measurable impact at global scale.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Define and champion the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models across Search, Recommendations, and Conversational AI.  Set the architectural standard and drive system design for critical, high-leverage ML platforms across Mobility and Delivery.  Lead cross-team initiatives spanning Retrieval, Ranking, Personalization, and LLM-powered assistants, resolving complex technical trade-offs across organizational boundaries.  Define long-term investment areas (build vs fine-tune vs partner models) with clear business rationale and long-term viability.  Provide principal-level technical leadership, mentoring Staff and Senior Staff engineers, and setting the bar for technical excellence across the entire AI organization. 

 Basic Qualifications: 

 Masters degree or Ph.D in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics  12+ years of ML experience, including significant work on large-scale deep learning systems.  Demonstrated ownership of high-impact ML systems in search, recommendations, or conversational AI.  Deep expertise in transformers, retrieval systems, ranking, and embedding architectures.  Strong experience with PyTorch and distributed training.  Proven ability to set the technical strategy for a large organization and influence product roadmaps at the executive level.  Strong product intuition and ability to connect model improvements to business outcomes. 

 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Track record of successfully launching multi-year, multi-org ML initiatives that drove step-change business outcomes.  Successfully championed and driven the adoption of multi-year technical roadmaps across multiple large engineering organizations.  Elevated engineering standards through mentorship and technical leadership, establishing org-wide best practices.

About the Role At Uber, we don't just use tools; we build the engines that power global movement. As an Application Developer for Work Management, you are at the heart of our productivity, designing and building the Atlassian-based systems that keep thousands of Uber employees aligned and moving fast.

This isn't just about managing Jira tickets-it's about engineering intelligent, integrated ecosystems. The pace here is intense, the systems are massive, and the stakes are high. You'll navigate complex technical debt and architect solutions for problems that don't have a playbook. We need a systems-level thinker with the grit to dive into enterprise-scale configurations and the curiosity to leverage GenAI and Rovo Agents to redefine what's possible. If you stay calm under pressure and care deeply about building tools that actually work at scale, this is where you'll thrive.

What You'll Do

Build and Scale: Design and optimize Jira and Confluence environments that support how our teams move in the real world-where performance and reliability are non-negotiable.Develop Custom Solutions: Build secure, scalable cloud applications directly within the Atlassian ecosystem, where your hands-on experience with Atlassian Forge app development and the Forge platform will be a distinct advantage.Navigate Complexity: Solve messy, high-impact problems across the Atlassian toolchain (Structure, JEMH, EazyBI, ScriptRunner) when the playbook doesn't exist.Automate the Future: Build and maintain AI-powered applications and Atlassian Rovo Agents to automate workflows and eliminate manual friction.Integrate Deeply: Develop robust integrations using Atlassian REST and GraphQL APIs, ensuring seamless data flow across our global tech stack.Own the Outcome: Drive projects end-to-end-from initial requirement gathering with stakeholders to debugging production issues when the stakes are high.Unblock Teams: Champion engineering best practices to work through technical debt and shifting priorities, even when time is tight.Collaborate and Influence: Partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations to navigate tension, influence without authority, and ship practical, high-speed solutions.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of combined experience in software engineering and/or Atlassian platform administration and development (Jira/Confluence Cloud or Data Center).Deep proficiency in Jira workflows, custom fields, schemes, permissions, and advanced enterprise configurations.Hands-on experience with Atlassian Forge app development and the Forge platform.Experience using ScriptRunner for complex automation and workflow enhancement.Experience working with Atlassian REST and GraphQL APIs for third-party integrations.Experience managing and configuring Atlassian marketplace apps (e.g., Structure, JEMH, EazyBI).Demonstrated use of AI-powered developer tools in daily engineering workflows (e.g., AI-assisted coding or debugging).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Atlassian Rovo Agents and LLM integrations.Expertise in prompt engineering and defining agent actions within enterprise workflows.Proven ability to design enterprise-scale dashboards and analytics using EazyBI.Experience supporting large, complex organizations with rigorous governance requirements.Strong systems thinking and the ability to thrive in high-ambiguity environments.

rows.title: Associate Merchandiser (Shoes & Sandals)
rows.descriptionText:
Dr. Martens is more than a brand - it’s a global icon with over 60 years of attitude, heritage, and cultural impact. We’re a thriving, values‑driven business powered by diverse thinkers, bold doers, and people who bring their whole selves to work. If you’re ready to make your mark, you’re in the right place.

At DM, our values guide everything we do: Be Yourself, Act Courageously, Show You Care. They’re not just words - they’re how we turn passion into progress.

WHERE YOU SIT

As our Associate Merchandiser (Shoes & Sandals), you’ll be part of the Brand team working closely with brilliant people across the business and reporting into Merchandiser (Shoes & Sandals). You’ll be right at the heart of fast‑moving projects that shape how we show up for our consumers - today and tomorrow.

WHERE YOU CONTRIBUTE

The Associate Merchandiser supports the planning, execution, and optimisation of Dr. Martens’ global product assortment across key categories. This role is integral to ensuring that the product offer is consumer-centric, commercially robust, and aligned with the brand’s growth ambitions. Working closely with Marketplace Merchandising, Product Management, Finance, Brand, and Marketplace & GTM teams, the Associate Merchandiser helps deliver a compelling, globally consistent product offer that drives profitable growth and strengthens brand equity.

Core Accountabilities

As our Associate Merchandiser (Shoes & Sandals), you will be responsible for:

Supporting development and management of the global product assortment, balancing icons, franchises and newness to drive growth and profitability across regions and channels.Analysing sales data, market trends and consumer insights to inform range architecture, lifecycle management and local market adaptations.Contributing to seasonal planning, ensuring alignment with commercial targets, strategic priorities and integrated go-to-market execution.Collaborating cross-functionally with Merchandising, Product, Brand and Marketplace teams to track performance, optimise sell-through and manage inventory health.Championing data-driven tools and continuous improvement, strengthening merchandising processes, decision-making and team capability.


Key Skills & Capabilities

Put simply, the key things we’re looking for are:

Strong understanding of merchandising fundamentals, including range planning, product lifecycle management and consumer-focused decision-making.Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales data, market trends and insights to inform product and assortment strategies.Collaborative team player with experience working cross-functionally in matrixed, global organisations.Clear and confident communicator, able to present ideas, insights and data effectively to stakeholders.Digitally and data fluent, with strong attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced environments and proficiency in Excel and analytics tools.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Hybrid workingWelcome free pair of Docs‘Buy as you Earn’ Share scheme65% off all Docs50% off AccessoriesPension Scheme through AvivaLife Assurance25 Days Annual Leave + Bank HolidaysPrivate healthcare2 paid volunteer days per year


READY TO FILL YOUR BOOTS?

If you’re excited to own your impact, shape the future of an iconic brand, and grow your career in a place that champions individuality - we’d love to hear from you.

At Dr. Martens, we are committed to creating an environment in which we can all be our best and bring our authentic selves to work. We encourage applications, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, or disability. Diverse and inclusive teams have a positive impact on our brand; helping us to speak authentically to our consumers.

We strive to develop a business where our people can thrive and feel empowered to express themselves. Because we believe everyone should feel supported and included whatever their role in the Dr. Martens community.

rows.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

Global Platform builds the shared services, tools, and engineering foundations that help eBay teams deliver product changes faster, improve reliability, and reduce operational risk.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll serve as Global Platform’s primary product partner for one of eBay’s company priorities. You’ll work with product, engineering, architecture, and VP-level leaders. Together, you’ll identify the results teams need, connect them with the right platform services, and address gaps that block progress.

You’ll turn business and technical needs into a shared roadmap, coordinate commitments across teams, and measure progress through adoption, migrations, service health, operational efficiency, and customer impact. This role is a good fit for someone who makes complex systems understandable and helps teams move from ambiguity to action.

Come help us make eBay’s shared platform services easier to adopt and more useful across the company!

What you will accomplish

Learn the assigned area’s goals, architecture, delivery plan, dependencies, and risks.Connect those needs with existing platform services, tools, owners, and adoption paths.Identify adoption barriers and capability gaps, then turn them into clear product opportunities and investment recommendations.Set priorities and maintain a shared roadmap for platform adoption, migrations, new capabilities, and cross-team commitments.Evaluate technical options with engineering and architecture, including scalability, reliability, security, and operational impact.Define ownership, sequencing, milestones, decisions, and success measures. Surface risks early and present practical options.Track and communicate progress using adoption, usage, migration, service health, operational, and customer measures. Bring recurring team needs into Global Platform planning.Identify, evaluate, and scale responsible AI-enabled capabilities that accelerate product delivery, improve customer engagement, and deliver measurable business outcomes.


What you will bring

rows.descriptionText:

About The Team And The Role

eBay’s Customer Experience teams build the technology and platforms that support buyers and sellers across the globe. AI is creating new possibilities for these experiences, and we’re building the technical foundation to bring them to life across eBay. That means solving complex architecture questions around how models connect with enterprise knowledge, tools, and workflows while working seamlessly with the platforms our customers rely on today.

We’re looking for a Sr. Member of Technical Staff, AI & Agentic Architect within Global Platforms to help shape what comes next! You’ll lead architecture across agentic systems, orchestration, and platform integration, creating patterns that teams can build on as the technology evolves. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to influence both the technical decisions we make today and how agentic capabilities evolve across eBay over time.

Hybrid Requirement: 3 days in office and 2 days from home. Primary location: Austin, TX; also open to Portland, OR, and Salt Lake City, UT.

What You Will Accomplish

Define architecture for agentic Customer Experience capabilities, bringing together models, orchestration, retrieval, tools, workflows, decisioning, policy, evaluation, and human support.Establish reusable patterns and platform boundaries that help teams build and operate AI-enabled experiences across customer journeys and service channels.Architect how agents interact with enterprise knowledge, APIs, tools, workflows, case management, and policy systems while meeting high standards for reliability, security, performance, and customer trust.Shape how agentic systems operate at scale, including approaches to evaluation, observability, resiliency, latency, model selection, and token and infrastructure costs.Evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, orchestration approaches, and industry patterns to identify technologies that can strengthen the platform and improve how teams build.Validate critical architecture decisions through prototypes, technical spikes, reference implementations, and design reviews, turning successful approaches into capabilities that teams can adopt.Lead technical alignment across teams, navigating complex tradeoffs and connecting architecture decisions to customer needs, engineering priorities, and long-term platform health.


What You Will Bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant depth designing and architecting large-scale distributed systems and production platforms.Proven experience architecting and shipping AI/ML or Generative AI systems into production, with meaningful ownership of architecture, technical decisions, and outcomes.Strong knowledge of modern AI system architecture, including agentic systems, orchestration, tool use, retrieval-based architectures, conversational AI, or intelligent workflows.Deep distributed-systems expertise across APIs and service boundaries, event-driven systems, data and state management, scalability, resiliency, latency, and observability.Hands-on experience integrating AI into complex production environments, connecting models and agents with enterprise knowledge, APIs, tools, workflows, or transactional systems.Technical depth that extends from architecture into implementation, with experience using prototypes, reference implementations, technical investigation, and design or code reviews to validate important decisions.Cross-organizational technical leadership, with experience setting direction across multiple engineering teams and influencing senior engineers and cross-functional partners.Strong engineering judgment when balancing quality, safety, security, performance, operational complexity, and cost at significant scale.Experience with Customer Experience, Customer Service, contact center technology, conversational AI, or voice/IVR platforms is valuable but not required. Specific model providers, vector databases, and agent frameworks will continue to evolve. We value strong architectural fundamentals, production experience, curiosity, and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and apply them to complex engineering problems.

$217,600 - $290,500

rows.title: Principal, Corporate Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Company

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be part of the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be a part of.

With ~150 million active buyers across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit www.ebayinc.com

About The Team

We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The corporate strategy has a reputation of solving the most challenging problems and coming up with innovative and out-of-the-box solutions, with recommendations grounded in data.

We work very closely with senior leadership and have a high visibility. Team members can have a fast-track career in strategy or move into the business after 1-2 years.

The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: 1) we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, 2) we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, 3) we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The eBay corporate strategy team is seeking a Principal, Corporate Strategy. Within this role, you will lead a cross-functional strategy project and a team of a few strategy team members. You will work with key stakeholders from all functions across the organization to craft strategies and drive structured and data-based recommendations to action. In this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay, working with eBay’s senior executives. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems. You can either build a career in eBay’s strategy team or use this as stepping stone into other business and product roles at eBay.

Role Responsibilities

Project leadership: Lead cross-functional projects to solve strategic business problems, working with senior eBay executives. Projects are usually 2-4 months long, staffed with 1-3 team members supporting the Principal. Topics can span eBay’s overall strategy, category strategies, buyer/seller strategies or functional strategies (e.g., payments, ads) or other relevant strategic topics Insights generation: Work with your team and analytics/ data science support to define smart analyses and generate new, compelling insights. Visualize in simple and compelling ways. Use the insights to develop key recommendations grounded in data Strategy Development: Define and structure the core problem, understand status quo & competitive dynamics, define ambitions and value proposition and create recommendations for key actions to solve the problem Communication: Develop compelling and concise storylines to communicate team’s recommendation; prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership People leadership: Develop a team of associates and managers to constantly improve and help them grow their career 


Job Requirements

Intellectual curiosity Skilled in project management and strategy development, including project prioritization, hypotheses development, financial and business modeling, strategic options identification, consensus building, and implementation Outstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative), ability to define relevant analyses in a hypothesis-driven approach, generating new & groundbreaking insights grounded in data Excellence in structured thinking, developing creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. Ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive business Strong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions. Ability to create clear and simple storylines. Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives. Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team members Comfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environment Comfort in handling uncertainty Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with! 


Qualifications

Proven leader with at least 7+ years of work experience - experience at a top strategy consulting firm is a must; Experienced project managers, currently working at top strategy consulting companies. Leaders who spent at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting company and then advanced their careers for 4-5 years at a startup or corporate Bachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferred Expertise in technology and/or in e-commerce/retail is a plus 


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work.. rows.title: Search Engine Marketing Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Associate, Search Engine Marketing manages and analyzes SEM campaigns, overseeing their creation, management, and optimization. They analyze campaign performance data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to improve performance and return on ad spend (ROAS). The Associate creates reports, dashboards, and visualizations to effectively communicate performance metrics to internal stakeholders and senior leadership, making data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

Manage large-scale ad budgets and optimizations to meet target goals.Triage performance issues, providing clear and actionable recommendations for improvement, and collaborate with the team to develop performance improvement plans as needed.Ensure availability during peak holiday seasons to monitor and maintain campaign performance.Work with bidding platforms and manage complex account structures, including product feeds, to drive large-scale account performance.Report on campaign performance to senior management, offering insights and recommendations for future campaigns.Build and maintain relationships with platform partners to access new features and opportunities.Provide leadership and mentorship to specialist team members.Collaborate with other marketing teams, such as communications planning, marketing effectiveness, and site merchandisers, to align efforts.Ensure all deliverables are quality-assured and client-ready for internal stakeholders.Understand SKU/product priorities and identify opportunities to drive performance.Attend weekly leadership meetings with site merchants and leadership to present findings and recommendations for optimal performance.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Skills You Will Need

SEM Strategy and Execution: Deep understanding of SEM strategies within the retail industry, including audience segmentation and omni-channel campaigns.

Bid Platforms and Tools Proficiency: Expertise in using platforms such as Skai (formerly Kenshoo), ProductsUp, and other bid management tools to optimize performance and drive sales.

Data Analysis and Optimization: Strong ability to analyze campaign performance using analytics tools like Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics, and translate findings into actionable, data-driven insights for optimization.

Budget Management: Proven experience managing large-scale ad budgets, implementing effective bidding strategies, and maximizing ROAS while meeting business goals.

Campaign Performance Monitoring: Expertise in testing, experimenting, and optimizing campaigns through various ad formats and hypotheses to achieve better results.

Communication and Reporting: Excellent communication skills for presenting complex performance data and insights to internal stakeholders and senior leadership.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as communications, site merchandising, and platform partners, ensuring SEM strategies align with overall business objectives.

Leadership and Mentorship: Strong leadership and mentorship capabilities, guiding specialist team members and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Ability to stay up-to-date with SEM trends, algorithm changes, and industry best practices, applying them to drive successful outcomes.

Technical and Strategic Thinking: Ability to think creatively and strategically, balancing both technical expertise and broader business goals to optimize SEM performance.

Problem-Solving: Demonstrated capability in triaging performance issues, providing clear solutions, and developing improvement plans when necessary.

Attention to Detail: Strong focus on quality assurance, ensuring that all work is delivered at the highest standard and meets stakeholder expectations.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 4-6 years of experience and a general understanding of e-commerce and the digital advertising eco-system. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discounts Performance-based incentives Annual merit review Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice Tuition reimbursement 

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here. 

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

MARKETING00

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

Job Description

Our Opportunity:

At Chewy, Financial Intelligence is building trusted, scalable, and well-governed data solutions that enable Finance and Accounting teams to make faster, more informed decisions. We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer II to design, develop, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support financial reporting, analytics, planning, and operational decision-making across the enterprise.

In this role, you will focus on transforming complex financial and operational data into reliable, well-structured, and reusable data models using dbt Cloud and Snowflake. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Analytics, and other business partners to understand business processes, define requirements, and translate those needs into scalable technical solutions and trusted data products.

The ideal candidate brings strong SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and data modeling expertise, along with the ability to work directly with business users and explain technical concepts in clear business terms. rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead planner enablement strategy and execution for Cvent’s Attendee Hub, reporting to the Director of Product Management. You will own the roadmap and outcomes for a suite of AI-powered experiences, anchored in the Cvent Assistant, that help event planners accomplish their jobs faster and with greater confidence. You will run a dedicated sprint team and partner closely with engineering, design, and data science to define what gets built, why it matters, and whether it’s working.

In This Role, You Will

Own the end-to-end roadmap and execution for planner-facing AI experiences in Attendee Hub, extending the Cvent Assistant across configuration, designer, and core workflow surfaces.Embed AI as a default lens in discovery, asking how AI improves the job to be done before writing requirements.Own end-to-end development of AI-powered features, defining what “good” looks like through structured evals: building eval datasets, writing LLM-as-judge prompts, and monitoring quality in production.Use AI fluently in your daily PM work for research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, and model that behavior for the team.Run continuous discovery: weekly customer conversations, early assumption testing, and working prototypes rather than slide decks.Make prioritization decisions using Mixpanel, Sigma, and ProductBoard, answering your own questions rather than waiting on analyst support.Lead a dedicated sprint team, running backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and delivery cadence.Write short, opinionated specs paired with working prototypes and evals, with clear acceptance criteria ready before sprint start.Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain, surfacing deviations with a proposed remedy.Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on go-to-market launches and post-release adoption.

Here’s What You Need

Bachelor’s degree required.5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.Experience designing and shipping AI-powered features, including hands-on work with prompt engineering and evals.Fluency with AI prototyping tools (such as Lovable, v0, Claude, or Cursor) to build working artifacts that inform discovery.Proficiency with analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Sigma, Pendo, or similar), comfortable defining KPIs and making evidence-based decisions without analyst support.Proven ability to run your own customer interviews and synthesize feedback directly into product direction.Experience partnering with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment, with a solid grasp of software development and system design.Exceptional communicator who writes direct, clear recommendations backed by reasoning.Self-starter who moves on ambiguous problems without waiting for direction and brings options, not just problems.

rows.title: Sr. MTS, AI & Agentic Architect
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

eBay’s Customer Experience teams build the technology and platforms that support buyers and sellers across the globe. AI is creating new possibilities for these experiences, and we’re building the technical foundation to bring them to life across eBay. That means solving complex architecture questions around how models connect with enterprise knowledge, tools, and workflows while working seamlessly with the platforms our customers rely on today.

We’re looking for a Sr. Member of Technical Staff, AI & Agentic Architect within Global Platforms to help shape what comes next! You’ll lead architecture across agentic systems, orchestration, and platform integration, creating patterns that teams can build on as the technology evolves. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to influence both the technical decisions we make today and how agentic capabilities evolve across eBay over time.

Hybrid Requirement: 3 days in office and 2 days from home. Primary location: Austin, TX; also open to Portland, OR, and Salt Lake City, UT.

What You Will Accomplish

Define architecture for agentic Customer Experience capabilities, bringing together models, orchestration, retrieval, tools, workflows, decisioning, policy, evaluation, and human support.Establish reusable patterns and platform boundaries that help teams build and operate AI-enabled experiences across customer journeys and service channels.Architect how agents interact with enterprise knowledge, APIs, tools, workflows, case management, and policy systems while meeting high standards for reliability, security, performance, and customer trust.Shape how agentic systems operate at scale, including approaches to evaluation, observability, resiliency, latency, model selection, and token and infrastructure costs.Evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, orchestration approaches, and industry patterns to identify technologies that can strengthen the platform and improve how teams build.Validate critical architecture decisions through prototypes, technical spikes, reference implementations, and design reviews, turning successful approaches into capabilities that teams can adopt.Lead technical alignment across teams, navigating complex tradeoffs and connecting architecture decisions to customer needs, engineering priorities, and long-term platform health.


What You Will Bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant depth designing and architecting large-scale distributed systems and production platforms.Proven experience architecting and shipping AI/ML or Generative AI systems into production, with meaningful ownership of architecture, technical decisions, and outcomes.Strong knowledge of modern AI system architecture, including agentic systems, orchestration, tool use, retrieval-based architectures, conversational AI, or intelligent workflows.Deep distributed-systems expertise across APIs and service boundaries, event-driven systems, data and state management, scalability, resiliency, latency, and observability.Hands-on experience integrating AI into complex production environments, connecting models and agents with enterprise knowledge, APIs, tools, workflows, or transactional systems.Technical depth that extends from architecture into implementation, with experience using prototypes, reference implementations, technical investigation, and design or code reviews to validate important decisions.Cross-organizational technical leadership, with experience setting direction across multiple engineering teams and influencing senior engineers and cross-functional partners.Strong engineering judgment when balancing quality, safety, security, performance, operational complexity, and cost at significant scale.Experience with Customer Experience, Customer Service, contact center technology, conversational AI, or voice/IVR platforms is valuable but not required. Specific model providers, vector databases, and agent frameworks will continue to evolve. We value strong architectural fundamentals, production experience, curiosity, and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and apply them to complex engineering problems.


Additional Details

The applicable base pay range for this position is dependent on work location. The base pay range in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Metro and Seattle Metro is expected in the range below:

$217,600 - $290,500

The base pay range for all other U.S. work locations is expected in the range below:

$156,800 - $255,300

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

rows.title: Head of Membership & Loyalty UK (12-Month Maternity Cover)
rows.descriptionText:
Head of Membership & Loyalty – UK (12-Month Maternity Cover)

Location: London, Arbor Office (Southwark)

Contract Type: 12-month fixed term contract

At Merlin, we create extraordinary experiences that bring people together through play. As Head of Membership & Loyalty for the UK, you will help shape how millions of guests connect with our brands, creating programmes that turn great days out into lasting relationships. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, ensuring our membership and loyalty proposition continues to delight guests while driving sustainable commercial growth.

Working closely with global and UK teams, you'll lead the development and execution of Merlin's membership and loyalty strategy across the UK portfolio. You will translate global frameworks into locally relevant propositions, ensuring our programmes remain competitive, customer-centric and aligned with commercial priorities.

You will champion the end-to-end member experience, partnering with Go-to-Market, CRM, Digital, Commercial and Attraction teams to deliver seamless journeys across every touchpoint. From acquisition and engagement to retention and lifetime value, you will use insight, innovation and data-led decision making to optimise performance and unlock new opportunities for growth.

As a senior leader, you'll act as the key UK partner for Global Membership & Loyalty, influencing future programme development and sharing market insights that help shape the wider Merlin roadmap. You will also build strong partnerships internally and externally, ensuring every member experience reflects the high standards and sense of connection that make Merlin special.

This role will take ownership of an upcoming membership platform transition, leveraging strong product expertise and working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience throughout the change. The position will also maintain a close partnership with Legal and Compliance teams, particularly in preparation for anticipated regulatory changes in the spring. In addition, the role is responsible for planning and delivering marketing campaigns across key limited-time offer (LTO) and promotional periods throughout the year, driving engagement and commercial performance. As a people leader, the successful candidate will also be responsible for managing and developing two direct reports.

Why Merlin?

Join the team behind some of the world's favourite places to play. At Merlin, every magical moment starts with our people. If you're looking for a role where you can shape the future of membership and loyalty, work with brilliant teams and create experiences that bring families closer together through play, we'd love to hear from you.

Merlin. It's where we play!

 Significant experience leading membership, loyalty or subscription programmes at scale  Proven success developing and delivering strategic roadmaps that drive customer engagement and commercial performance  Strong commercial acumen with the ability to use data, insight and analytics to inform decisions and influence outcomes  Experience operating within complex, consumer-facing organisations, ideally across multiple markets  Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, CRM and digital engagement strategies  Experience managing budgets, forecasting and performance reporting  Ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders across multiple functions  Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate across teams, regions and external partners  Excellent communication and presentation skills  Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment  A creative, solution-focused approach with strong problem-solving capability  Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to inspire collaboration and drive results through others  A proactive mindset, high levels of accountability and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences 

Benefits

 40% discount off LEGO® sets and products on the online LEGO Store!  Merlin Magic Pass: 20 free tickets for you, your family and friends to enjoy all of our Merlin Attractions across the world!  25% discount in Merlin retail shops and restaurants (a brilliant extra treat when you’re using your Magic Pass to visit!)  Staff discount codes for Merlin Annual Passes to gift to loved ones!  Private pension scheme  Life assurance scheme  Employee assistance programme  Access to Perks at Work which 30,000+ national & local employee discounts  Ongoing training & development

rows.title: Carbon & Environmental Compliance Manager
rows.descriptionText:
At Merlin, we bring joy, create connections and make memories for millions of guests every year across our world-famous attractions. Behind the scenes, we are also working hard to make sure those memories are created in a more sustainable way.

That is where you come in.

We are looking for a Carbon & Environmental Compliance Manager to help drive the accuracy, governance and impact of Merlin’s environmental reporting across our global estate.

Working closely with teams across Sustainability, Finance, Procurement, Energy and Operations, you will take ownership of our Scope 1 and 2 carbon reporting, environmental compliance and performance analytics. You will ensure our environmental data is accurate, auditable and meaningful, helping the business make informed decisions that support our sustainability ambitions.

This role combines carbon accounting, environmental compliance and data analysis. One day you might be reviewing greenhouse gas emissions data from attractions across the world, the next you could be identifying opportunities to reduce energy consumption, improve environmental performance or strengthen compliance processes.

What You Will Be Doing

 Leading Merlin's annual Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas reporting across 100+ locations  Maintaining carbon accounting methodologies in line with the GHG Protocol and relevant regulations  Coordinating the collection, validation and assurance of environmental data  Managing packaging compliance and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) reporting  Producing environmental dashboards, reports and performance insights for senior stakeholders  Supporting internal audits, external assurance processes and regulatory reporting  Delivering environmental reporting training and guidance to teams across the business  Monitoring environmental legislation and assessing potential business impacts  Supporting wider ESG and sustainability reporting and initiatives 

This is a permanent contract, based in our Poole office, Basingstoke office or flexible, working 4 days per week.

Qualifications & Experience

You will likely have experience in environmental compliance, carbon accounting, sustainability reporting or environmental data management within a complex, multi-site organisation.

You Should Also Bring

 Strong practical knowledge of Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas reporting and the GHG Protocol  Experience managing large datasets with a focus on data quality, governance and assurance  Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate data into business insight  Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working across multiple functions  Experience supporting environmental compliance and regulatory reporting requirements  Advanced Excel skills and experience using data analysis or visualisation tools  Strong project management and organisational capability  A degree in environmental science, sustainability, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience 

This role would suit someone who enjoys digging into data, challenging assumptions and helping turn environmental information into practical action that delivers measurable business impact.

Benefits

 40% off LEGO online  25% discount in our retail shops and restaurants  Private Medical Insurance (Single cover)  Merlin Magic Pass - giving you free tickets to all our attractions worldwide for you, your family, and friends every year  Enjoy the ride pass – giving you and 5 others a Merlin annual pass (Gold edition)  X2 volunteer days a year  Discounted rates at Merlin hotels all over the world  Employee pricing up to 55% off cinema tickets

Polyphonic Surgery is at an important stage of growth, with a strong foundation and an opportunity to expand its impact across new markets and health systems. Job Description

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Description

Johnson & Johnson Services Inc. is recruiting for a Director, Deployment Leader to be preferably located in located in Raritan, NJ.

Caring for the world, one person at a time has inspired and united the people of Johnson & Johnson for over 125 years. We embrace research and science -- bringing innovative ideas, products, and services to advance the health and well-being of people. Employees of the Johnson & Johnson work with partners in health care to touch the lives of over a billion people every day, throughout the world. Johnson & Johnson is the world's most comprehensive and broadly based manufacturer of health care products, as well as a provider of related services, for the consumer, pharmaceutical, and medical devices and diagnostics markets. Thriving on a diverse company culture, celebrating the uniqueness of our employees and committed to inclusion. Proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

The Deployment Leader will be a part of the MedTech Supply Chain Digital Transformation Program and will be accountable for the delivery of Transcend Transformation Programs, a series of highly complex multi-year business and technology transformation initiatives. The candidate will be accountable for overall project governance, project planning, project management, risk management, resource management, project communications, solution readiness, business readiness, and transition to steady-state.

Furthermore, the candidate will act as the primary leadership conduit partnering closely alongside the Business Lead, Technology Lead, and Value Stream Leads to ensure all program objectives are met as well as partner across interdependent programs to ensure dependencies are managed and risks mitigated.

Major Responsibilities

 Responsible for leading, shaping, and influencing all Project Management Office related activities and team members. Ensure Final Project Objectives (FPOs) are met by release while delivering on quality, scope, schedule, and budget. Lead overall PMO cadence, mechanics, and day-to-day execution of the program across all workstreams. Partner closely with the Portfolio and Program Management peers to ensure appropriate communication of key interdependencies, risks, and performance metrics. Active member of the Program Leadership Team and share the responsibility of making the overall effort a success. You will bring in your thought leadership, holistic thinking, action orientation, creative problem solving, and listening skills. You are a role model for the other members on the project team. Forge robust working relationships with all key business partners and interdependent programs. Be a role model of the deployment methodology and agile way of working. Ensure the project follows deployment best practices and stage-gate governance processes to ensure a quality solution is delivered on-time, on budget, and on-quality. Ensure the Agile methodology is applied both in the development work but more broadly across the project as well so that the drumbeat / rhythm is followed in all areas and by all teams on the project. Develop and deliver program presentations for senior-level MD stakeholders.

Qualifications

 Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or MBA is desirable Requires a minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in leadership roles within Operations, Supply Chain, or large transformation programs. Requires a minimum of 5 years of Program Management leadership experience on large complex business transformation programs Requires strong knowledge of MedTech, Medical Devices, Supply Chain or Commercial Operations Demonstrated hands-on project management/delivery required Excellent interpersonal and negotiating skills, with proven ability to influence/collaborate to get to desired result Requires people management and development experience Strong customer focus (internal & external), including development and management of stakeholders Certification in areas of expertise (e.g., PMP, APICS, Lean/Six Sigma /Process Excellence, etc.) is helpful Strong analytical and quantitative skills, excellent communication and presentation skills are required. Strength in interdependent partnering and team management is required. The ability to effectively manage projects, timelines, and change management is required. Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, making the complex clear and compelling to all levels of the organization in both written & oral forms is required. Ability to embed a culture of harmonization and process improvement and value creation across the business is required. Position located primarily in NJ. Other J&J MD office locations in NA or EU may be considered. Requires Travel: up to 25% domestic and international. Clear understanding of external Supply Chain trends and emerging best practices. Strong influencing role in shaping the journey for future of our Digital Transformation Roadmap is preferred.

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for the position of a Senior Financial Analyst, US Joint Reconstruction Selling. The preferred locations are New Jersey sites (Raritan, Titusville), Raynham, MA, Palm Beach Gardens, FL, or West Chester, PA.

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Position Overview

The primary scope of the Senior Financial Analyst role is to serve as a business partner to the DePuy Synthes Joint Reconstruction Commercial team. The analyst will provide critical financial insights and influence business decisions that impact business objectives and proactively provide executive level communication regarding financial results.

Responsibilities

Lead financial planning and forecasting for the Joint Reconstruction selling budget, including managing selling expenses across forecast cycles, explaining variances to prior forecasts and targets, and identifying risks and opportunities.Deliver detailed financial reporting and actionable insights to selling leadership to support informed decision-making and achievement of financial commitments.Facilitate the development and evaluation of commission structures for the Joint Reconstruction selling organization, providing financial analysis and strategic guidance.Build and manage effective relationships with cross-functional partners across DePuy Synthes to support the achievement of financial commitments.Provide financial guidance for ongoing projects by consolidating data, assessing risks and opportunities, developing recommendations, and presenting insights to leadership.Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, SOX compliance, and finance requirements associated with the organizational transition.Demonstrate agility by supporting evolving priorities across the Joint Reconstruction and broader DePuy Synthes teams and proactively developing knowledge of diverse areas of the business.

Qualifications

Education:

A minimum of a bachelor’s degree is required; a major in Accounting or Finance is preferred but not required.CPA, MBA, CMA or other related certification is preferred.

Experience And Skills

A minimum of three years of finance, business experience or related leadership experience is required.Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required.Advanced Excel and Presentation skills required.Collaborative and inquisitive style while working with a cross-functional organization with many partners is required.Ability to apply data and strong analytics to influence executive decision making is required.Ability to work independently while collaborating with various levels of management and external customers is also required.Strong analytical skills with attention to detail is required.This role may require up to 10% domestic travel.

rows.title: Manager, Financial Due Diligence, TMT
rows.descriptionText:
Connect to your IndustryThis is your opportunity to join Deloitte's M&A Transaction Services team.
Working on high profile assignments with some of the best in the field, you will have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects, with a mix of both corporate and private equity transactions, within a highly commercial, client focussed environment.
Our core services include acquisition and vendor financial due diligence, bid defence and support and reporting accountant services for capital market transactions. Typically, we work within a wider deal team which accesses the firm's vast range of specialist expertise including commercial and operational due diligence, sale and purchase agreement negotiation, real estate, treasury, pensions, modelling, fund placement, merger integration, IT and business intelligence. We also often work on international assignments involving cross-border as well as cross-service line teams requiring our people to build wide networks across both the UK and International firm.
We encourage consideration of flexible ways of working, both formal and informal arrangements that allow for the best outcomes for our people and our clients. If this opportunity is of interest to you with some flexibility, please do discuss with us.
Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunityOur team provides clients with dedicated support for a transaction or potential transaction. Typically, this involves the investigation of the target from a variety of perspectives to ensure significant value items, risks and other matters have been identified and considered by our client and assisting them in making an informed decision regarding the transaction.
Responsibilities:Quickly develop an understanding of the target business and its driversInterpretation and analysis of information memoranda, business plans, publicly available information on the target businessReview and analysis of historical trading, cash flow and balance sheetsReview and analysis of projections, and underlying assumptionsReview of the adequacy of working capital facilities, including consideration of financing limits, term and covenantsEvaluation of potential synergiesReporting of potential key issues for our client including identification of risk or price affecting considerationsReview of sale and purchase agreement and correlating findings of due diligence process thereinReview of financial structures and associated credit agreementsWork effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.
Connect to your skills and professional experienceEssentials:An ACA qualification or equivalent/experienceExperience in M&A Transactions, Financial Due Diligence or significant experience in a relevant industryHigh level report writing and reviewing skills, with an appropriate focus on attention to detail, conciseness and risk managementExceptional academic background or equivalent experienceGood problem solving and analytical skillsExperience of operating with senior level stakeholdersStrong excel skills with an ability to quickly and accurately manipulate dataStrong commercial acumen and market awarenessStrong client management skills with a focus on delivering high quality serviceExcellent communication and presentation skillsDesirables:Fluency in a major European foreign language would be an advantage
Connect to your business - Strategy, Risk & Transactions AdvisoryIn an ever-evolving world, there are no certainties in business. Our teams help clients to navigate risks, process major transactions and deliver transformational change that will future-proof their business. Join us to make a positive difference.
Mergers and AcquisitionsWe challenge dealmakers to expect more and to see beyond the deal to create sustainable value for shareholders, employees and society. We support corporates, private equity and financial investors across the full M&A lifecycle and are committed to identifying and delivering sustainable value at every stage of the deal.
Personal independenceRegulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.
Connect with your colleagues“Deloitte gives you lots of opportunities to hone your skills and an open-door approach from the senior leadership makes it a great organisation to build your career with.” - Aditya, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory
Our hybrid working policyYou’ll be based in Manchester with hybrid working.At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.
Our commitment to youMaking an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next stepA career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

rows.descriptionText:
Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ?

Stage de fin d’études (6 mois) à pourvoir à partir de septembre 2026 ou janvier 2027.

Basé au cœur de la City à Londres, dans un bureau neuf, moderne et accueillant, Constantin est le bureau régional de Deloitte France au UK. Il est spécialisé dans l’audit de filiales UK de groupes audités par Deloitte (essentiellement Deloitte France). Aujourd’hui, le bureau londonien connait une forte croissance et compte plus de 150 professionnels.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons pour le département Audit, des stagiaires désireux de travailler dans un environnement jeune et international.

En rejoignant notre bureau Londonien, vous aurez l’opportunité :

D’évoluer au sein d’une structure jeune et dynamique en forte croissance où le travail d’équipe et de terrain sont clé ;De bénéficier des outils, de la méthodologie et du parcours de formation de Deloitte France dans un environnement anglophone et anglo-saxon qui vous permettront de développer vos compétences techniques.D’embarquer dans la transformation en profondeur du métier d’Auditeur avec une approche d’audit incluant l’utilisation de nouvelles plateformes d’audit et de nous outils de data analyse et intelligence artificielle ;


Être auditeur aujourd’hui, c’est être au cœur de multiples expertises : financière, IT, Data Analytics, IA, ESG… Vous alliez analyse, curiosité et vision stratégique pour accompagner les transformations des organisations et garantir leur fiabilité. Acteur clé de la performance durable, vous collaborez avec des experts de tous horizons au sein du réseau Deloitte, en France comme à l’international.

En rejoignant notre bureau Londonien, vos missions seront : 

En tant que stagiaire Audit, vous aurez les mêmes responsabilités qu’un Junior Analyste Audit, vous participerez à des missions variées tant auprès de filiales UK d'importants groupes cotés (filiales de sociétés françaises du CAC 40) qu'auprès d’ETI et d’entreprises familiales à fort potentiel de croissance.
